0084148c9296.en: “There you go, Harry! Now let’s get cracking!” A fatherly smile appeared on Itagiba’s face as he herded the stranger, now named Harry, away from the southwest tower he had come from, towards two other identical towers not far away.
0084148c9296.t: “好了，哈利！现在开工吧！”伊塔吉巴脸上露出慈父般的笑容，把这个现在名叫哈利的陌生人从他出来的西南塔赶开，带向不远处另外两座一模一样的塔。

019009103f45.en: “So that’s a toilet?” Harry saw the light coming from the stone completely falter as Sora dumped the water down the toilet.
019009103f45.t: “所以那是马桶？”哈利看着索拉把水倒进马桶，石头发出的光完全熄灭了。

01ad690e5152.en: “That’s us, bud! Long story, though, and I need to go get your badge ready. Sora, can you put extra soap in the bathwater?” A grin arose on Itagiba, the Sanbi King. “He’s gonna need it.”
01ad690e5152.t: “那就是我们，兄弟！不过说来话长，我得去把你的身份牌准备好。索拉，你能在洗澡水里多放点肥皂吗？”桑比国王伊塔吉巴咧嘴一笑。“他会用得上的。”

0564758476ed.en: His brow furrowed. A strong stench of death mixed with a strong oily musk raped his nose, burning deep like taking a big whiff of bleach; his bronchioles deep within his lungs screamed in agony. With no warning, he suddenly sneezed his brains out, popping their eyes out of their sockets—at least that's what the sensation of pain felt like as no actual brain matter came out, nor did his eyes free themselves.
0564758476ed.t: 他皱起眉头。一股浓烈的死亡恶臭混着浓重的油腻麝香味粗暴地侵犯着他的鼻子，像猛吸了一大口漂白水那样一路烧到深处；他肺部深处的细支气管痛苦地尖叫。毫无预兆地，他突然打了一个惊天动地的喷嚏，仿佛脑浆都要喷出来、眼珠都要从眼眶里蹦出来——至少疼痛的感觉是这样，实际上并没有脑浆流出来，眼睛也没有挣脱出来。

05fe38f53863.en: “It’s a half timehunk, sir.” Sora opened another drawer, and grabbed a round metal object, opened it in half, and pointed it against the window. “Have you ever seen a timekeeper before?”
05fe38f53863.t: “那是半个 timehunk，先生。”索拉又拉开一个抽屉，拿出一个圆形的金属物件，把它打开成两半，对着窗户。“您以前见过泰姆基珀吗？”

072038900e0b.en: Her cheerfully cyan eyes were like pearls, but those pearly eyes did not dare gaze at him, instead she gazed towards the cityscape in the backdrop of the window beside them. “Hi King! Is this gentleman the new guest?” Her voice was a sweetly feminine voice that sounded like a lullaby—a rap lullaby that she ended with a stiff posture, anxiously waiting for orders.
072038900e0b.t: 她那双欢快的青色眼睛像珍珠一样，但那双珍珠般的眼睛不敢看他，而是望着他们身旁窗外作为背景的城市景色。“国王您好！这位先生就是新来的客人吗？”她的声音甜美而女性化，听起来像一首摇篮曲——一首说唱摇篮曲，唱完后她便僵直地站着，焦急地等待吩咐。

082320fe85df.en: A crunchy sound, followed by an orgasmic hum came out of the lard ass entertaining himself. The taco, filled with carne asada, lettuce, tomatoes, and thick chunks of cheddar, became a single mush of flavor explosion in his mouth, all brought together by chimichurri sauce. But the flavor explosion didn’t last long, for it was quickly sent down his gullet by a refreshing, frizzy light ale that had a slightly bitter and malty taste that gave way into a slightly sweet aftertaste.
082320fe85df.t: 一声嘎吱的咀嚼声，接着是一声高潮般的哼哼，从这个自娱自乐的肥猪嘴里冒出来。那个塔可里塞满了烤牛肉、生菜、番茄和大块切达奶酪，在他嘴里化作一团爆炸性的美味，全靠阿根廷青酱把它们融为一体。但这美味爆炸没持续多久，就被一口清爽、起泡的淡色艾尔啤酒送下了喉咙，那啤酒带着微苦的麦芽味，最后化为一丝淡淡的回甘。

09f013ffb206.en: Ask her to wash your back. Itagiba’s voice came to his mind again, but Harry blew the idea off with a quick head shake. There’s no way I can ask her that.
09f013ffb206.t: 让她给你搓背。伊塔吉巴的声音又一次浮现在他的脑海里，但哈利飞快地摇摇头，把这个念头甩开了。我怎么可能开口让她做那种事。

0a366c9227e2.en: Tears poured out of his eyes as he felt nothingness taking his last memory away from him. Amidst the tears flowing through his greasy cheeks, a white sparkle of light appeared in the distance, moving randomly, with disregard to the laws of physics, searching for something as if it was a UFO in the sky. One second it was barely the size of a penny, then next it was the size of a car as it zoomed around in the darkness, appearing as if searching for something.
0a366c9227e2.t: 当他感到虚无正夺走他最后的记忆时，泪水从他眼中涌出。在泪水淌过他油腻的脸颊时，远处出现了一点白色的光芒，随意地移动着，无视物理定律，像空中的不明飞行物一样在寻找着什么。前一秒它还只有一枚硬币那么大，下一秒就变成一辆汽车那么大，在黑暗中飞速穿梭，仿佛在搜寻什么。

0a4f4b8d9b9b.en: “Don’t step on them or she’s gonna get cranky!” Itagiba warned as he stepped carefully around them.
0a4f4b8d9b9b.t: “别踩到它们，不然她会发脾气的！”伊塔吉巴一边提醒，一边小心地绕开它们。

0ab14db837a5.en: Feeling violated, the stranger covered his belly button, nervously laughing along with Itagiba. Ehh? That’s weird.
0ab14db837a5.t: 陌生人觉得自己受到了侵犯，捂住肚脐，跟着伊塔吉巴紧张地笑了起来。呃？真奇怪。

0ccb1cf8bdba.en: A slightly cold breeze flooded the room, bringing a salty air alongside the noisy rustles of the vibrating city down below. With a large breath of fresh air, Harry felt the stagnant air come out of his lungs. Damm. Those taco farts are still just as bad—wait—didn’t I have my own place too? Harry, looking at the blur of houses in this foreign city, tried to juggle his memory, but the only thing that appeared was a resemblance of a red recliner, and a TV in front of it. What happened to it? Did I lose all my money, then end up in the slums? But then why can't I remember anything? Is that why everything feels so off?
0ccb1cf8bdba.t: 一阵略带凉意的微风灌进房间，带来了咸咸的空气，还有楼下那座充满活力的城市的嘈杂声。哈利深吸了一大口新鲜空气，感觉到肺里那股滞闷的空气排了出去。该死。那些塔可屁还是一样难闻——等等——我不是也有自己的住处吗？哈利看着这座陌生城市里模糊的房屋，试图翻找自己的记忆，但唯一浮现出来的只是一张红色躺椅和它前面一台电视的样子。它后来怎么了？我是把钱都花光了，然后沦落到贫民窟的吗？可那为什么我什么都想不起来？难道这就是一切都感觉不对劲的原因？

0ec97c84affd.en: An offbeat smile shone on Neferteri, appearing to partake in enjoying this stranger’s misfortune. With a joyous tone, she spoke slowly, “Don’t despair. Please take solace in the fact that we do know some facts about you.”
0ec97c84affd.t: 奈菲尔特丽脸上露出一个古怪的笑容，似乎在享受这个陌生人的不幸。她用愉快的语气慢慢说道：“别绝望。请你安心，我们确实知道一些关于你的事实。”

0f20b0f36579.en: “A—a race, like the Naked Bruntos, sir?” Sora replied in an inquisitive tone of her own.
0f20b0f36579.t: “一个——一个种族，就像裸布伦托斯那样，先生？”索拉用她自己那种探询的语气回答。

0f39c383bfdb.en: “Oh! I’m sorry!” Harry flipped the lamp upright again, rattling the stones even more.
0f39c383bfdb.t: “哦！对不起！”哈利把灯重新摆正，让石头晃得更厉害了。

10ed3829c5cc.en: Harry, huffing as he carefully watched his step, reached the midway point of the second flight of stairs. From the corners of his eyes, he noticed something quickly walking down towards him; gasping amidst inhaling, he saw a girl far cuter than sexy. Her fiery red hair contrasted her black maid clothing with blue accents. Her small mouth had a charming, embarrassed smile, and two cutesy canines poking from below that looked like inverted vampire fangs. Her flushed skin was so visible that it appeared as if she had rosacea.
10ed3829c5cc.t: 哈利喘着粗气，小心地看着脚下，到达了第二段楼梯的中段。他从眼角瞥见有个东西正快步朝他走下来；他一边吸气一边倒抽一口凉气，看到了一个与其说性感不如说可爱得多的女孩。她火红的头发与带蓝色点缀的黑色女仆装形成对比。她的小嘴挂着迷人而羞涩的笑容，下面还探出两颗可爱的犬齿，看起来就像倒过来的吸血鬼獠牙。她泛红的皮肤那么明显，看起来就像得了酒糟鼻。

141d320ad979.en: A hum came out of Harry, his hand scratching the short stubble beard of his. “I’m sorry, but what is Darfaries?—”
141d320ad979.t: 哈利哼了一声，挠了挠他短短的胡茬。“对不起，可达尔法里斯是什么？——”

1446bfee3acf.en: “I—dunno?” The stranger spoke, revealing his hands, shrugging until he remembered the stone he found in the ground earlier. I guess that has a nice sound to it. “Nari?”
1446bfee3acf.t: “我——不知道？”陌生人摊开双手，耸了耸肩，直到他想起之前在地上发现的那块石头。我觉得那个听起来不错。“纳里？”

15933339b31d.en: “Hehe—that’s a new one—hey—remember to save it for Maiara as that’s why you’re here.” With a wink and a thin-lipped devious smile, Itagiba slapped Harry’s arm twice, then went his way down the stairs, only to turn his head back towards him. “By the way, you missed an opportunity to grab her hands, and give them a kiss.” Itagiba gave a smooth fingerbang, with a click of the tongue, then started walking down again. With his back to Harry, he said out loud, “But you can still ask her to wash your back! I will allow that!” He gave a thumbs up, disappearing into the stairs below.
15933339b31d.t: “嘿嘿——这条是新的——嘿——记得把这留给迈阿拉，那才是你来这里的原因。”伊塔吉巴眨了眨眼，抿着嘴露出一个狡黠的笑容，拍了拍哈利的胳膊两下，然后自己下楼去了，却又回过头来看着他。“对了，你错过了一个握住她的手、亲一亲她手的机会。”伊塔吉巴潇洒地比了个手指手枪，咂了一下舌头，然后又开始往下走。他背对着哈利大声说：“不过你还是可以让她给你搓背！我准了！”他竖起大拇指，消失在下面的楼梯里。

15d746c69715.en: This other floor was different from the others. The room itself was an open concept room split into two sides, with a corridor in the middle blocked by an old-looking wheelbarrow that led to a large door on the opposite side. On the left, flesh, bone, and feathers pickled in bottles of who-knows-what were all stacked up to the ceiling against the wall. In front of them, small and large cauldrons, workbenches, and knives stood closer to the corridor—truly a witch’s wet dream. What the fuck is all this? The stranger felt as if he just entered a haunted house, where everything felt unnatural or surreal.
15d746c69715.t: 这一层和其他几层不一样。房间本身是一个开放式的空间，分成两边，中间有一条走廊，被一辆看起来很旧的独轮车挡着，走廊通向对面的一扇大门。左边，泡在不知装着什么的瓶子里的肉、骨头和羽毛靠墙一直堆到天花板。它们前面，大大小小的坩埚、工作台和刀具靠近走廊摆放着——简直是女巫的春梦。这他妈都是些什么？陌生人觉得自己像刚走进了一座鬼屋，一切都显得不自然或超现实。

1686703b94cf.en: He felt his gut churn as one last memory rose, appearing as if it was unlocked, his soul unable to kept it protected any longer—he was a young skinny boy, back in his lovely childhood home, with a large grin on his face as he sat in between his parents, eating tacos, while a black-and-white chubby dog begged for food at their feet.
1686703b94cf.t: 当最后一段记忆浮现时，他感到胃里一阵翻腾，那段记忆仿佛被解锁了一般，他的灵魂再也无法守住它——那时他还是个瘦小的男孩，在他那温馨的童年家里，脸上挂着大大的笑容，坐在父母中间吃着塔可，一只黑白相间、胖乎乎的狗在他们脚边讨吃的。

168ed133b7ff.en: Wait. Eleven is smaller than thirteen. The stranger computed the numbers on his head, trying to make sense of it all, at least until he saw Itagiba look at him and wink. Ohhhhh. I think I get it. The stranger kept muddling over the wink, and possible interpretations.
168ed133b7ff.t: 等等。十一比十三小。陌生人在脑子里算着这些数字，想弄明白这一切，至少在他看到伊塔吉巴看着他眨了眨眼之前是这样。哦——我想我明白了。陌生人一直琢磨着那个眨眼，以及它可能的含义。

1706d20b8f19.en: The stranger gulped. “I—I remember me and my parents were eating tacos when I was a kid—” The stranger felt the darkness come alive, grappling his heart, suffocating his lungs, but it was nothing but a vivid memory. “We’re watching—”
1706d20b8f19.t: 陌生人咽了口唾沫。“我——我记得小时候我和爸妈在吃塔可——”陌生人感到黑暗苏醒过来，攫住他的心脏，让他的肺窒息，但那不过是一段鲜明的记忆。“我们在看——”

17eec29c1831.en: Sora looked up, towards the ceiling, “Eight. Sixteen, with quarter time hunk would be thirty-two in a day. I’m truly sorry, sir, but I do not know what twenty-four hours correlate to.” Sora’s toothy lips saddened, holding the fost lamp at her side, taking a longer bow.
17eec29c1831.t: 索拉抬头望着天花板。“八个。十六个，按四分之一 timehunk 算，一天就是三十二个。真的非常抱歉，先生，可我不知道二十四个小时对应的是什么。”索拉那露着牙的嘴唇显出难过的样子，她把福斯特灯拿在身侧，久久地鞠了一躬。

18313572d40e.en: “Ohhhh!” Harry murmured to himself, analyzing what initially appeared to be a circular makeup palette. There were eight color zones in the circle, with a blue emblem of an engraved fish sticking out in the middle. The four colors on the left were warmer in nature, while the right ones were cooler. Within each of those eight colors, there was a white word splitting the color in two. Harry read them clockwise as Monna, Monni, Monno, Munnu, Sunna, Sunni, Sunno, Sunnu. “This feels—pretty different. Wait—why is this chunk kinda lightened up?” Harry noticed half of one of the colors, at around ten o'clock, having a certain bioluminescence to it. It contrasted the other half, divided by a word that spelled out Sunno, with a darker orange color, akin to the inside of a pink grapefruit.
18313572d40e.t: “哦——！”哈利自言自语地嘟囔着，打量着这个起初看起来像圆形化妆盘的东西。圆圈里有八个颜色区域，中间凸起一个刻着鱼的蓝色徽章。左边的四种颜色偏暖，右边的偏冷。在这八种颜色里，每种颜色中间都有一个白色的词把颜色分成两半。哈利按顺时针方向读出它们：蒙纳、蒙尼、蒙诺、蒙努、苏纳、苏尼、苏诺、苏努。“这感觉——相当不一样。等等——为什么这一块有点亮？”哈利注意到大约十点钟方向的一种颜色有一半带着某种生物荧光。它与被一个拼作苏诺的词隔开的另一半形成对比，那一半是更深的橙色，就像粉红葡萄柚的果肉。

185b4e7d7173.en: Making his way up to the fourth floor, he was panting as if he was about to have a heart attack. Exchanging quick eye contact with a portable-size cutesy maid called Sora, Harry smiled, wiping the sweat off his forehead.
185b4e7d7173.t: 走上四楼时，他喘得像是心脏病要发作了。哈利和一个叫索拉、袖珍般可爱的女仆迅速对视了一眼，擦掉额头上的汗，笑了笑。

1912782ccd41.en: Despite the bustling city noises coming from outside the walls, an eerie silence ensued; everyone stood by, eager to know more, even Nina, the child in pink, and the black soulless eyes of the “Extra THICC” goth chicken she was mounted on—at least it appeared interested for a little bit, as it then quickly bobbled its head towards the ground to peck at something. The stranger admired the sheer size of the maybe-more-emo-than-goth chicken, almost as tall as the child in pink. “Ahhhh—I woke up in that tower?” The stranger pointed to the tower he just came out of.
1912782ccd41.t: 尽管城墙外传来熙攘城市的喧闹声，这里却陷入了一种诡异的寂静；所有人都站在一旁，急切地想知道更多，连穿粉色衣服的孩子妮娜、还有她骑着的那只“超级肥厚”的哥特鸡那双漆黑无神的眼睛也是如此——至少那只鸡看起来感兴趣了那么一会儿，随即很快就把头往地上一点一点地啄起什么来。陌生人惊叹于这只也许比哥特更像情绪摇滚风的鸡的庞大体形，它几乎和那个穿粉色衣服的孩子一样高。“啊——我是在那座塔里醒来的？”陌生人指了指他刚刚走出来的那座塔。

199adea1f9af.en: At the top of the spiraling stairs, his vision could not distinguish where one step started and the other ended, and it felt like a long way down if he dared to misstep. He held onto the blue, with accents of drying blood rails, as if his life depended on it. One step after the other, he made his way halfway down the flight of stairs, to another open window inviting him to see outside. He saw the same blurry bustling city from another angle, yet he could not recognize anything remotely familiar.
199adea1f9af.t: 在螺旋楼梯顶端，他的视力分不清一级台阶从哪里开始、另一级在哪里结束，如果他敢踩错一步，那可是要摔很长一段路。他紧紧抓住那根蓝色、沾着干涸血迹的扶手，仿佛性命全靠它了。他一步接一步地走到楼梯中段，那里又有一扇开着的窗户邀请他往外看。他从另一个角度看到同样模糊、熙熙攘攘的城市，却仍然认不出任何稍微熟悉的东西。

19b0a8f2f083.en: “THIRTEEN!” Itagiba shouted back, so enthusiastically that the stranger felt he was in the middle of a stock exchange.
19b0a8f2f083.t: “十三个！”伊塔吉巴热情地喊了回去，让陌生人觉得自己仿佛置身于证券交易所中央。

1a47850f3ee1.en: “You’re just like us, bud. I guess you’ve never seen a Wozefaries before, huh? Lemme tell ya, Sora is one of the cutest out there—right Sora?” Itagiba gave a wink to her.
1a47850f3ee1.t: “你和我们一样，兄弟。我猜你以前从没见过沃泽法里斯吧？告诉你，索拉是最可爱的那种之一——对吧，索拉？”伊塔吉巴朝她眨了眨眼。

1c2c84f342c9.en: Harry watched the blur of this foreign city, and the people going about their business, while his mind slowly drew distant with conflicting thoughts, and no single solid answer.
1c2c84f342c9.t: 哈利看着这座陌生城市模糊的景象，以及忙着各自事务的人们，而他的思绪在相互矛盾的念头中慢慢飘远，却没有一个确切的答案。

1d20dee562d5.en: Eori was the first to pull her hand off the shake. Twitching her nose in disgust, she stepped back and put a fair amount of distance between them. Next, she seemed to isolate her hand from touching anywhere else in her body—acting like she had just touched a leper.
1d20dee562d5.t: 埃奥丽率先抽回了手。她嫌恶地抽了抽鼻子，往后退了一步，和他拉开了相当一段距离。接着，她似乎刻意让那只手不碰到身上任何其他地方——就像刚刚摸过一个麻风病人。

1df312cf60d0.en: Harry, glancing at a blur that was Sora’s small hands, caught a red thing on the back of both of them. He worryingly pointed at it, his voice followed next “Ahhh—is that blood? Are you okay?”
1df312cf60d0.t: 哈利瞥了一眼索拉那双模糊的小手，发现两只手背上都有个红色的东西。他担心地指着它，接着开口道：“啊——那是血吗？你没事吧？”

1eb69c0eec21.en: With widened eyes at the TV, his laugh turned into gasp. Without looking away, his grubby hands felt around three tacos to his right, knowing exactly what the flavors were: carne asada, campechanos, and chorizo. Feeling adventurous, he selected the campechanos this time as every time he chewed on it, he felt a burst of a unique combination of leftover meat, plus special seasonings like cumin and cilantro, that his favorite taco shop would create—like opening a loot box, but rather than useless crap; it was a unique flavor experience.
1eb69c0eec21.t: 他睁大眼睛盯着电视，笑声变成了倒吸一口凉气。他目不转睛，脏乎乎的手在右边的三个塔可上摸索着，清楚地知道它们的口味：烤牛肉、混合肉和墨西哥辣香肠。这次他想冒冒险，选了混合肉的，因为每次嚼它，都能尝到他最爱的塔可店做出的剩肉加孜然、香菜等特制调料的独特组合在嘴里迸发——就像开战利品箱，只不过开出来的不是没用的垃圾，而是独一无二的风味体验。

204ec134908e.en: Feeling a sense of nothingness taking over, he clung tightly to his chair, no longer even knowing what color it was, nor its shape. He breathed out, but could no longer breathe in, and the more he tried, the more pain he felt from his collapsing lungs. The pain mutated into sheer agony, bringing the certainty of death to his door, causing his life to flash by in his head. However, the memories did not look vivid, but rather closer to old photos left to rot, barely being able to recognize what the memories were to begin with. He saw places that faintly felt familiar, but as he tried to remember them, he saw many more rotted memories pass by—like an unstoppable train disappearing in the horizon, never to be seen again. With each passing moment of pure darkness and agony, everything he knew, as corrupted as it was, became nothingness.
204ec134908e.t: 感到一种虚无正在接管一切，他死死抓住椅子，甚至已经不知道它是什么颜色、什么形状了。他呼出一口气，却再也吸不进来，越是用力，塌陷的肺就越疼。疼痛变成了纯粹的煎熬，把死亡的必然带到了他的门前，让他的一生在脑海中闪过。然而，这些记忆并不鲜明，更像是任其腐烂的旧照片，几乎认不出原本是什么回忆。他看到一些隐约熟悉的地方，可当他试着去回想时，又看到更多腐烂的记忆闪过——就像一列势不可挡的火车消失在地平线上，再也不会出现。随着纯粹的黑暗与痛苦的每一刻流逝，他所知道的一切，无论多么残缺，都化为了虚无。

2227f7478bd5.en: Her voice reached Harry’s ears like a rap lullaby, but he then heard another familiar voice echo inside his head. You need to ask her to wash your back! “Can you?—” He tried to say it, but the words choked on his throat when her floppy ears and bright cyan eyes focused her attention on him. “Wash—eh?—I’m sorry. Oh! Humans! Is that the same thing as Naked Bruntos you mentioned early?” Harry let out an anguished breath.
2227f7478bd5.t: 她的声音像一首说唱摇篮曲一样传进哈利的耳朵，但随后他听到另一个熟悉的声音在脑海里回响。你得让她给你搓背！“你能——”他想说出口，可当她那耷拉的耳朵和明亮的青色眼睛把注意力集中到他身上时，那些话卡在了喉咙里。“搓——呃？——对不起。哦！人类！那和你刚才说的裸布伦托斯是一回事吗？”哈利痛苦地呼出一口气。

228ea442c32e.en: The stranger felt his heartbeat go up by ten percent for every step Princess Eori came closer to him—his own drama and problems felt being shoved aside by sheer passion. With her standing an arm’s length in front of him, his eyes were now able to tell just how beautiful she actually was. Her face was slightly flushed, but her lips were tightly shut—it looked like she was biting her tongue to hold back something. She extended her hands, and shook his weak-ass grip with the same intensity as her father, but she kept her distance. Oh wow! The stranger felt his heart trying to get out of his own mouth as his cold, sweaty hand was caressed by her warmth. In turn, his grip became not-so-weak-ass while a funny bubbly feeling erupted inside him, further pushing the personal drama into the sidelines.
228ea442c32e.t: 埃奥丽公主每朝他走近一步，陌生人就感到自己的心跳加快百分之十——他自己的那些烦恼和问题似乎都被纯粹的激情推到了一边。她站在他面前一臂之遥的地方，他的眼睛终于能看清她到底有多美了。她的脸微微泛红，但嘴唇紧紧闭着——看起来像是咬着舌头在忍住什么。她伸出手，用和她父亲一样的力度握了握他那软绵绵的手，但始终保持着距离。哇噢！陌生人感到心脏都要从嘴里跳出来了，他冰凉、汗湿的手被她的温暖抚过。相应地，他的握力变得没那么软绵绵了，一股好玩的气泡般的感觉在他体内迸发，把个人的烦恼进一步推到了一边。

23f89cd7fd28.en: “That, sir? That’s a fost stone lamp.” Playing with her hands, Sora tried to hide away the embarrassment swelling within her. “Excuse my question, but do you know what a couch is?”
23f89cd7fd28.t: “那个吗，先生？那是福斯特石灯。”索拉摆弄着双手，努力掩饰心里涌起的尴尬。“恕我冒昧，可您知道沙发是什么吗？”

251a4719a335.en: With that pressure out of his system, he brought himself back to his original position, and grabbed a chorizo taco, and pigged out on it, followed by another bottle of beer. Meanwhile, the TV’s white light, and it’s kinda-like-heavy-rain noise remained perfectly steady, but its brightness was slowly, but progressively diminishing, letting the darkness encroach closer.
251a4719a335.t: 释放了体内的压力，他把身体挪回原位，抓起一个辣香肠塔可狼吞虎咽，接着又是一瓶啤酒。与此同时，电视的白光和那种有点像大雨的噪音保持着完美的稳定，但亮度正在缓慢而渐进地减弱，让黑暗越逼越近。

2bb07e05212a.t: “电视，亲爱的。”奈菲尔特丽替他答道。

2bc56e384b83.en: “Whatever, then—anything else?” Itagiba looked probing towards the stranger, appearing to not take “no” as an answer.
2bc56e384b83.t: “算了——还有别的吗？”伊塔吉巴探询地看着陌生人，似乎不打算接受“没有”这个答案。

2e0845a5b412.en: “Your eyes are that bad, right? Well, grab her hand, and notice the bump. It is more like a nerve than a vein. See?” Itagiba smiled at Sora. “Give him a break, he just woke up from a near soul death.”
2e0845a5b412.t: “你的眼睛有那么差，对吧？好吧，握住她的手，感受一下那个凸起。它更像一条神经，而不是静脉。明白了吗？”伊塔吉巴朝索拉笑了笑。“别为难他，他刚从差点灵魂死亡的状态里醒过来。”

2ecf20b26a66.en: She said “R” twice in a row, making the same weird symbol. The fifth was a horizontal line that looked like a heart monitor that spiked down, then up-down, then down again. “Y!” She then ended her presentation by putting both hands up, and screaming as loud as she could, “HARRY! YAY!”
2ecf20b26a66.t: 她连说了两次“R”，比画着同样奇怪的符号。第五个是一条水平线，看起来像心电监护仪的波形，先向下一跳，然后上下，然后又向下。“Y！”最后，她双手高举，用尽全力尖叫着结束了她的表演：“HARRY！耶！”

2ee7b2722402.en: Is that why there was all the blood and such? The stranger thought back to the room he woke up in. He placed his hand on his chest, feeling his pretty-much-alive heartbeat. “—but how am I alive?” The words slipped from his mouth, picturing his own dead body, far fatter than what he actually was, rotting in the slums. “I thought once you die, you actually die.”
2ee7b2722402.t: 所以才会有那么多血什么的？陌生人回想起他醒来的那个房间。他把手放在胸口，感受着自己活蹦乱跳的心跳。“——可我怎么会活着？”这句话从他嘴里溜了出来，他想象着自己的尸体——比他实际上胖得多——正在贫民窟里腐烂。“我还以为人一旦死了，就真的死了。”

30cc3ce5bf5f.en: With the door to the bathroom closed, a stranger appeared on the back of the door. Harry raised his hand to say hi, but the stranger did it at the same time. Coming closer to compensate for his blurry eyes, Harry confirmed it was just a polished steel mirror pinned reflecting his own body. Touching his gut, he saw himself doing the same in the mirror. When did I lose weight, and become this hairy?—Maybe my time in the slums? But how did I end up there? Didn’t I work like—wait? Where did I work?
30cc3ce5bf5f.t: 浴室门关上后，门背后出现了一个陌生人。哈利抬手打招呼，那个陌生人也同时抬手。为了弥补模糊的视力，哈利走近一看，确认那不过是一面钉在门上的抛光钢镜，映出的是他自己的身体。他摸了摸肚子，看到镜子里的自己也在做同样的动作。我什么时候瘦下来的，还变得这么多毛？——也许是在贫民窟的时候？可我是怎么沦落到那里的？我不是在——等等？我在哪儿工作来着？

32744be95a13.en: “Huh?” He slowly revealed his face, easing them into the noises and sights from the world; the sounds of a brisling city now sounded like a symphony of normalcy: People talking and laughing, animals trotting, birds chirping, and even sounds of something hard steadily hitting wood not too far away.
32744be95a13.t: “嗯？”他慢慢露出脸来，让自己逐渐适应这个世界的声音和景象；熙攘城市的声音此刻听起来像是一曲平常的交响乐：人们的说笑声、动物的蹄声、鸟儿的啁啾声，甚至还有不远处某种硬物有节奏地敲击木头的声音。

3365a396fef0.en: “Aww shit. I forgot about that.” The towering man scratched his short hair, turning to the stranger “So—got anything in mind?”
3365a396fef0.t: “啊，该死。我忘了这茬。”高大的男人挠了挠他的短发，转向陌生人，“那么——有什么想法吗？”

33cce9408b5f.en: “Wow!” Harry, mouth-opened, saw pure magic happen in front of his eyes. “That’s amazing!”
33cce9408b5f.t: “哇！”哈利张着嘴，看着纯粹的魔法在眼前发生。“太神奇了！”

33ff62312909.en: Closing her eyes, Neferteri softly shook her head.
33ff62312909.t: 奈菲尔特丽闭上眼睛，轻轻摇了摇头。

34f656de70a1.en: “You’re welcome, Sir Harry. Please take your time. Dinner will be served at Monnalow.” Sora, with a curtsy posy, pulled on the sides of her black skirt, getting ready to leave.
34f656de70a1.t: “不客气，哈利先生。请慢慢来。晚饭在蒙纳洛开始。”索拉摆出屈膝礼的姿势，拉起黑裙子的两边，准备离开。

35873ced47ed.en: With squinting eyes, the stranger looked from person to person, trying to recognize them, but it was to no avail; they looked like strangers to him, too. That is until his eyes crossed paths with a beautiful girl in long violet hair that sparkled in the sun. He had never seen her before, but he now wanted to see her more. With an interested smile, the stranger wanted to take a step closer to really see her beautiful pinkish, or maybe purplish eyes, but his feet were planted firmly on the ground; too shy to move. At least he could see a bit of how her skin looked spotless and radiant, and even her demeanor, too! She looked away from him, holding back her tensed up posture, clutching her elbows tightly against herself, forcing a neutral face, only to start playing with her hair as the stranger kept staring on.
35873ced47ed.t: 陌生人眯着眼睛，一个接一个地打量这些人，试图认出他们，但无济于事；对他来说，他们也都是陌生人。直到他的目光与一个美丽的女孩相遇，她有一头在阳光下闪闪发亮的紫罗兰色长发。他以前从没见过她，但现在他想多看看她。陌生人带着感兴趣的微笑，想走近一步，真正看清她那美丽的粉色、或者说紫色的眼睛，但他的脚牢牢地钉在地上；太害羞了，迈不开步。至少他能看到一点她的皮肤是多么无瑕、多么光彩照人，还有她的举止！她把目光从他身上移开，克制着紧绷的姿态，紧紧地把手肘夹在身上，强装出一副面无表情的样子，可随着陌生人一直盯着看，她开始玩弄起自己的头发。

37bd531f821d.en: Meanwhile, Neferteri was gritting her teeth, at least for a bit before holding back her emotions when the stranger noticed an aura of unspoken anger coming from her—like the warmth irradiating from a fire. Meanwhile, Eori was keeping her distance, and mostly to herself by appearing to now enjoy the large clouds forming in the distance—apparently just biding time.
37bd531f821d.t: 与此同时，奈菲尔特丽咬紧了牙关，至少有那么一小会儿，直到陌生人察觉到她身上散发出一股无言的怒气——就像火焰辐射出的热量——她才把情绪压了下去。与此同时，埃奥丽保持着距离，基本上自顾自地待着，现在似乎正欣赏着远处正在形成的大片云朵——显然只是在打发时间。

3837b28637dc.en: Sora, quickly fumbling her fingers as if she was making gang signs, grew red as a tomato. “I don’t think I am, but—but thank you for your words, King.”
3837b28637dc.t: 索拉飞快地摆弄着手指，就像在比帮派手势，脸红得像个番茄。“我不觉得我是，不过——不过谢谢您的夸奖，国王。”

39bad48eb157.en: The pupils of his eyes adjusted themselves to the light in the room, allowing him to see a textured white, but blurry white ceiling. Slowly sitting up, his stiff body cracked all over, sounding like someone just popped a roll of bubble wrap. With a huge yawn, he involuntarily stretched himself, causing additional cracks, with one on his neck sounding like someone just snapped it. A constrained, nearly orgasmic, grunt came out of the stranger, feeling his tensed up muscles relaxing, like oiling up an old machinery.
39bad48eb157.t: 他的瞳孔适应了房间里的光线，让他看清了一片有纹理的白色天花板，虽然仍有些模糊。他慢慢坐起身来，僵硬的身体浑身噼啪作响，就像有人刚捏爆了一卷气泡膜。他打了个大大的哈欠，不由自主地伸了个懒腰，又引来一阵咔咔声，其中脖子那一声听起来就像有人刚把它拧断了。陌生人发出一声克制的、几乎像高潮般的哼声，感到紧绷的肌肉放松下来，就像给一台老机器上了油。

3f41597ee93d.en: With the intensity of the toothpaste dying down, a perfect amount of refreshing citrusy mixed with herbal tea remained in his mouth. All right. Tastes nice if it is just a bit—I guess. Gonna have to watch out for everything I think I know. Harry let out a deep breath, shoving the slightly wet toothbrush into the drawer, closing it, and making his way to the bathtub. He approached it with a growing suspicion, and slowly stuck his finger inside, waiting for perhaps what could be nearly boiling hot water to melt his finger away. Instead, the water had the right degree of warmth. Hmmmm. At least that feels normal. He took off his boxers in a fell swoop, slowly submersed one foot in, then stepped around to ensure it was an actual bathtub before immersing the rest of his corpulent body in, and letting it soak up the warmth.
3f41597ee93d.t: 随着牙膏的强度渐渐消退，嘴里留下了恰到好处的清爽柑橘味和草本茶香。好吧。只用一点的话味道还不错——我想。我得留神所有我以为自己知道的东西了。哈利深深呼出一口气，把有点湿的牙刷塞进抽屉，关上抽屉，朝浴缸走去。他越来越疑神疑鬼地靠近浴缸，慢慢把一根手指伸进去，等着那可能接近沸腾的热水把他的手指融化掉。结果水温恰到好处。嗯。至少这个感觉正常。他一下子脱掉短裤，慢慢把一只脚浸进去，又踩了踩确认这确实是个真正的浴缸，然后才把他那肥胖的身体其余部分也泡进去，让它吸收这份温暖。

4154051c8b34.en: “You okay there, bud?” Itagiba’s eyes grew concerned. He put his hand on Harry’s sweaty, stinky back, and pushed him forward. “C’mon! You can do it!”
4154051c8b34.t: “你还好吧，兄弟？”伊塔吉巴的眼神变得关切起来。他把手放在哈利汗湿发臭的背上，推着他往前走。“来吧！你能行！”

42aab3a3ce78.en: Chapter II subchapter 4: split panel of a cheerful red-haired maid waving on a staircase and Harry nervous beside a dark-haired man.
42aab3a3ce78.t: 第二章第 4 小节：分格画面，一边是在楼梯上开心挥手的红发女仆，一边是站在黑发男人身旁紧张的哈利。

49db26687570.en: “What else?” The towering man’s tone grew even blunter as his eyes were keen on the stranger’s expression.
49db26687570.t: “还有呢？”高大男人的语气变得更加直接，眼睛紧紧盯着陌生人的表情。

4aad84564a7c.en: “Fanbiro! C’mon!” Before Neferteri could even finish, Nina had already pulled the feathers of her goth bird, performing an exit maneuver with her mount.
4aad84564a7c.t: “凡比罗！走啦！”奈菲尔特丽还没说完，妮娜就已经拽着她那只哥特鸟的羽毛，带着坐骑来了个撤退动作。

4babe20c3ea7.en: Neferteri continued, “—and this lovely purple-haired-lady is the third princess Eori—”
4babe20c3ea7.t: 奈菲尔特丽继续说道：“——而这位可爱的紫发小姐是三公主埃奥丽——”

4cd44ffb4c05.en: The stranger chuckled as he saw Nina, with her hair flying up in the air, wildly giggling, and her trusted mount, leaving black feathers behind as they both ran towards the back of the castle, vanishing from sight.
4cd44ffb4c05.t: 陌生人看着妮娜头发在空中飞扬，咯咯地疯笑着，和她信赖的坐骑一起朝城堡后面跑去，身后掉落着黑色的羽毛，最后消失在视线中，他不禁轻笑起来。

50fe6063685f.en: Moving his attention to the rails of the upward spiraling stairs, Harry saw a small glimpse of a blurry image, of which his brain had just enough imagination to fill in the gap: yellow underwear with white embroidery belonging to the cutesy small legs of the fiery-red-haired maid.
50fe6063685f.t: 哈利把注意力转向向上盘旋的楼梯的扶手，瞥见了一小片模糊的影像，而他的大脑恰好有足够的想象力来填补空白：那个火红头发的女仆那双可爱的小腿上方，是一条绣着白花的黄色内裤。

54b46287720e.en: The child in pink pointed her tiny finger at the stranger. “MOM! He looks like Uncle Alford!” Her eyes shone in delight seeing someone familiar. “Even his belly, too!”
54b46287720e.t: 穿粉色衣服的孩子用小小的手指指着陌生人。“妈妈！他长得像阿尔福德叔叔！”看到一个熟悉的人，她的眼睛高兴得闪闪发光。“连肚子都像！”

55de836ce525.en: Chapter II subchapter 5: a red-haired maid holds out a round colored dial toward a seated man in a room with a bathtub.
55de836ce525.t: 第二章第 5 小节：一个红发女仆把一个圆形彩色表盘递向坐在带浴缸的房间里的男人。

57817b8b5dfd.en: His ears heard the usual sounds of a busy city, but somehow it felt amplified, as if they were screaming in his ears, obnoxiously loud. A soothing, slightly chill wind blew through the room, but he shivered as if someone just poured a bucket of icy water over him.
57817b8b5dfd.t: 他的耳朵听到的是繁忙城市的寻常声响，但不知为何这些声音被放大了，仿佛在他耳边尖叫，吵得令人厌烦。一阵舒缓、略带凉意的风吹过房间，他却打了个寒战，就像有人刚往他身上浇了一桶冰水。

581212151e4d.en: “Like—a part of a day? Twenty-four hours?” Harry showed the color swatch that somehow told the time to Sora, pointing at the lighted section. “Like wouldn't this be ten—ahhh.” Harry’s hands froze in the air like a mime. His mind clearly felt like there was something that came after ten, but it just wouldn’t come out. Ten hours? No—? Harry scratched his beard.
581212151e4d.t: “就是——一天的一部分？二十四个小时？”哈利把那个不知怎么能报时的色块盘给索拉看，指着亮起的那一段。“比如这不应该是十——啊。”哈利的手像哑剧演员一样僵在半空。他的脑子清楚地觉得十后面还应该有什么，可就是说不出来。十个小时？不对——？哈利挠了挠胡子。

586702c83837.en: “All right, Harry. What do you want for dinner?” Itagiba cracked his neck as he kept walking, passing by the middle tower.
586702c83837.t: “好了，哈利。晚饭想吃什么？”伊塔吉巴一边走，一边活动了一下脖子，经过中间那座塔。

5a1a1711bbfb.en: In the corridor, the wheelbarrow exuded a familiar odd smell. Taking a sniff of the air around him, the stranger’s mind clicked as to what it was. That smells just like the room I was in! Was I brought in then? He peeked at the wooden tiles in the ground and noticed the same faint bloodied footprints passing both ways in the corridor. Looking up, he saw the same glass, but this time metal instead of wood jars with whitish stones inside. That has to be a lamp, right?
5a1a1711bbfb.t: 在走廊里，那辆独轮车散发出一股熟悉的怪味。陌生人嗅了嗅周围的空气，脑子里咔嗒一下想到了那是什么。这味道和我刚才待的那个房间一模一样！难道我是被运进来的？他看了看地上的木地板，注意到走廊里同样有淡淡的血脚印，来回两个方向都有。他抬头一看，看到同样的玻璃，不过这次是金属而不是木头的罐子，里面装着发白的石头。那肯定是灯，对吧？

5a232622985a.en: Sora’s hand reached out to an apparent danger. “Please watch out for the glass or you might hurt your hand.”
5a232622985a.t: 索拉伸手去挡一个显而易见的危险。“请小心玻璃，不然可能会伤到手。”

611c5b346ae6.en: “Yeah. That. Do you know what that is?” Itagiba glanced at her.
611c5b346ae6.t: “对。那个。你知道那是什么吗？”伊塔吉巴瞥了她一眼。

61309207dd41.en: Meanwhile Sora’s eyes grew watery from the Bagarisa musk burning up her sensitive nose. Sounding as if she was stuffed, she tried to not breathe from her nose as she spoke up “Sir—is there anything else you need?”
61309207dd41.t: 与此同时，索拉的眼睛被那股灼烧她敏感鼻子的巴加里萨麝香熏得泪汪汪的。她听起来像鼻塞了一样，努力不用鼻子呼吸，开口说道：“先生——您还需要什么吗？”

617dd286fde2.en: “So, what else other than eating tacos and watching—what was it again?” Itagiba, the towering king, looked firmly back at the stranger.
617dd286fde2.t: “那么，除了吃塔可和看——那是什么来着？”高大的国王伊塔吉巴坚定地看着陌生人。

61bef16f8fc9.en: Eating the taco with the same voracity as the previous one, he then gulped down a large glass filled with Vienna lager like a camel. Putting the glass aside, he was ready to send in another taco when he paused his grubby hands, using it to bend his body to the right instead. His face contorted, and reddened—like a baby trying to poop. His butt cheeks, now spread out apart, gave way for a sudden gust of stench air to blow through, sounding like someone trying to whistle for the first time in their life.
61bef16f8fc9.t: 他以吃上一个塔可时同样的贪婪吃下这个塔可，然后像骆驼一样灌下一大杯维也纳拉格啤酒。他把杯子放到一边，正准备再送一个塔可下肚，脏乎乎的手却停住了，转而用它撑着身体往右边歪。他的脸扭曲变红——就像一个正在使劲拉屎的婴儿。他的两瓣屁股此刻分开，让一股突如其来的臭气吹了过去，声音就像有人生平第一次试着吹口哨。

62095e81f0e7.en: “I—I saw them disappear, and then I was left—alone. That’s it. Well, I remember everything being dark too—I thought it was my living room, but maybe it was a dream? I think?” The stranger’s eyes wandered away; he went silent as the crippling darkness began crawling back to his mind the further he pushed it to remember what happened.
62095e81f0e7.t: “我——我看着他们消失，然后我就被留下了——孤零零一个人。就这些。嗯，我还记得一切都很黑——我以为那是我家客厅，但也许是个梦？我想是吧？”陌生人的目光游移开去；他越是逼自己去回想发生了什么，那令人窒息的黑暗就越是开始爬回他的脑海，他便沉默了。

625dec64291c.en: “I—guess I can try. I never made them before though—” Harry and Itagiba entered the main floor of the Southeast tower—the tower opposite the one he had woken up in. The main floor was wildly different; no longer a witch’s wet dream, but rather a large living room of sorts with couches, stuff for painting, books, and glass jars that looked like lamps, but with whitish, pearly stones inside them that sparkled in the sunlight of the open window—kinda similar to the other ones he had seen in the other tower. In the nearby ground, drawings, with an awful lot of pink, littered the floor as if a tornado had passed through.
625dec64291c.t: “我——我想我可以试试。不过我以前从没做过——”哈利和伊塔吉巴走进了东南塔的一楼——这座塔正对着他醒来的那座。一楼完全不一样；不再是女巫的春梦，而是一间宽敞的起居室，里面有沙发、绘画用品、书，还有一些看起来像灯的玻璃罐，只是里面装着发白的、珍珠般的石头，在敞开的窗户透进来的阳光下闪闪发亮——和他在另一座塔里见过的那些有点像。附近的地上散落着一张张画，粉色多得吓人，就像刚刮过一阵龙卷风。

63bcf9dd7f0f.en: Harry, passing by the south tower, walking towards the southeast one, instantly remembered one thing only. “Hah—tacos?”
63bcf9dd7f0f.t: 哈利经过南塔，朝东南塔走去，脑子里立刻只想起了一样东西。“哈——塔可？”

64644be325e7.en: Feeling a squeeze on his breath, and a sinking heart, the stranger took one last glance at the cute girl in purple—feeling like she had already dumped him before he even had the chance to say hi. Turning his attention to the unwavering will coming from this tall man, he felt like he had no choice but to shake his hand. As their hands met, the stranger imagined his hand being crushed by his tight grip, but instead the handshake itself felt rather welcoming; his own slightly cold hands, and weaker grip, were met with a firm, supportive handshake. “Ah—sorry—ahhh—but I don’t know.” Muttering words came out amidst hums from the stranger, looking up to the red, fiery, but somehow natural-looking eyes of this tall man.
64644be325e7.t: 陌生人感到呼吸一紧，心往下沉，他最后看了一眼那个穿紫色的可爱女孩——感觉还没来得及打招呼，她就已经把他甩了。他把注意力转向这个高大男人那不可动摇的意志，觉得自己别无选择，只能和他握手。两人的手相握时，陌生人想象着自己的手会被他紧紧一握捏碎，但相反，这次握手本身感觉相当亲切；他自己那略显冰凉的手和较弱的握力，迎来的是一次坚定而有力的握手。“啊——抱歉——啊——可我不知道。”陌生人在一阵哼哼声中嘟囔着，抬头看向这个高大男人那双火红、却又不知为何显得很自然的眼睛。

650c890e8eed.en: Quickly bowing, Sora replied in her usual rap freestyle fashion—at least in terms of speed. “Yes, King! I will do it immediately!” The maid then took off upstairs in a rush as if her life depended on it.
650c890e8eed.t: 索拉飞快地鞠了一躬，用她惯常的即兴说唱方式回答——至少在语速上是这样。“是，国王！我马上就去！”女仆随即飞奔上楼，仿佛性命攸关。

66cf3aab4584.en: Harry, realizing where his mind was at, let go of her nearly-violated hand. “Thank you—ah—Sora.” His hands and imagination still wanted to play with it some more, but then he remembered the words Marry a princess. Paying close attention to her humanoid figure as she stepped back, he then noticed her ears were pretty different from what a normal ear was; hers had a pointy shape, like an elf’s, but it flopped inward like certain dog breeds. Touching his own ear, Harry felt the normal roundness instead.
66cf3aab4584.t: 哈利意识到自己的心思跑到哪儿去了，放开了她那只差点被侵犯的手。“谢谢——啊——索拉。”他的手和想象力还想再玩一会儿，但随后他想起了那句话：娶一位公主。她往后退时，他仔细观察她的人形身影，这才注意到她的耳朵和正常的耳朵很不一样；她的耳朵是尖的，像精灵的耳朵，但又像某些品种的狗那样向内耷拉着。哈利摸了摸自己的耳朵，感觉到的是正常的圆润。

675b68d03ec2.en: A small chuckle came out of Itagiba. “Pfff—you sure? That’s kind of lame, you know? We can give you a better name.”
675b68d03ec2.t: 伊塔吉巴轻笑了一声。“噗——你确定？那有点逊，你知道吗？我们可以给你起个更好的名字。”

68292393253f.en: “I’m sorry, sir, but what is an hour?” Sora’s ear perked up, trying to listen to Harry as clearly as she could.
68292393253f.t: “对不起，先生，可小时是什么？”索拉的耳朵竖了起来，努力把哈利的话听得清清楚楚。

69ecb9b97d9a.en: “Nina Sanbi Royal!” Neferteri, the only one not laughing, called out to her in the same vibe that a Latino mother would right before taking out one of her sandals and performing a headshot with it. However, she did not reach out for hers, or whatever else she wore under her long blue dress. Rather, she remained calm, at least in how she composed herself.
69ecb9b97d9a.t: “妮娜·桑比·罗亚尔！”奈菲尔特丽是唯一一个没笑的人，她叫妮娜的那股架势，就像拉丁裔母亲在掏出一只拖鞋来个爆头之前的那一刻。然而，她没有去拿自己的鞋，也没有去拿长长的蓝裙子底下穿着的任何东西。相反，她保持着冷静，至少在仪态上如此。

69fa0a254c16.en: “I’m sorry—but what is Monnalow?” Harry held his face as if was about to be told that’s enough.
69fa0a254c16.t: “抱歉——可蒙纳洛是什么？”哈利捂着脸，仿佛马上就要听到一句够了。

6a265c8fd422.en: Nina bowed before making her way back into the castle, savoring the victory of her newly struck deal.
6a265c8fd422.t: 妮娜鞠了一躬，然后回到城堡里，品味着她新谈成的这笔交易的胜利。

6a2c1e9650a1.en: Harry went to take a step to follow her, but the king gripped his arm again, holding him in place.
6a2c1e9650a1.t: 哈利正要迈步跟上她，国王却又抓住了他的胳膊，把他按在原地。

6c9c427ec7fa.en: Spitting some of the syrup into the sink, he then pulled on the handle attached to the pipe to let the water flow. Sticking his mouth into the pseudo waterfall, a refreshing taste came through, only to then turn into as if he was swallowing cold water from a freezing lake. Coughing his lungs out, while trying to breathe through the pain, he agonized, trying to use the toothbrush to scrape off this powerful concoction of his tongue.
6c9c427ec7fa.t: 他把一些糖浆吐进水槽，然后拉动连在管子上的把手让水流出来。他把嘴凑进这道假瀑布里，先是尝到一股清爽的味道，随即就变得像在吞冰冻湖泊里的冷水。他咳得肺都快出来了，一边忍着痛呼吸，一边痛苦地试图用牙刷把这强劲的调和物从舌头上刮下来。

6d693f8cfd73.en: On the right, bookshelves were filled with all kinds of books in different shapes and colors, with some looking so old that they would probably curse you or fall apart into dust the moment you opened it—truly the kind of gift to someone with rhinitis. But the books were not the only thing decorating the right side of the room; weirdly shaped two-finger rings, that looked like what a flashy rapper would wear, decorated a section of the wall. In front of that was a table with grinders dirty with blue dust and boxes in a familiar green wood color that contained blue stones and blue dust. At the base of the table, a large, raw, unpainted wood crate was filled with used diamond-like colored stones, looking pretty close to what the stranger had seen back in the room he woke up in.
6d693f8cfd73.t: 右边，书架上摆满了各种形状和颜色的书，有些看起来古老得一翻开就会诅咒你，或者化成一堆灰——绝对是送给鼻炎患者的好礼物。但装饰房间右侧的不只有书；墙上的一块区域装饰着形状古怪的双指戒指，看起来就像浮夸的说唱歌手会戴的那种。它前面是一张桌子，上面放着沾满蓝色粉末的研磨器，还有颜色眼熟的绿色木盒，里面装着蓝色石头和蓝色粉末。在桌脚下，一个未上漆的大原木箱里装满了用过的、像钻石一样颜色的石头，和陌生人在他醒来的那个房间里看到的非常相似。

6dd9428a4446.en: Weird. The stranger took his time walking to the door, looking at how foreign everything looked.
6dd9428a4446.t: 真奇怪。陌生人慢慢地朝门口走去，看着周围的一切多么陌生。

6e799b14cb87.en: Feeling like she dumped him a second time, the stranger could not think of anything to say, instead an ass-licking smile appeared on him as he looked at his own self, realizing he was in the wrong, making the bubbly feeling inside him fizzle out like a soda left open in the fridge.
6e799b14cb87.t: 感觉自己又被她甩了一次，陌生人想不出该说什么，反而露出了一个谄媚的笑容，低头看看自己，意识到错在自己，那股气泡般的感觉就像一瓶开着盖放在冰箱里的汽水一样泄了气。

6f5513a8bdbf.en: “—I don’t remember much, but—Oh! The—doggo! I can’t remember his name either, but he was black and white. We were watching TV while he begged for food—he disappeared. Then—so did my parents. I, somehow, felt old and fat after that—lonely too.” The stranger’s voice tapered at the end. He looked at the ground, feeling an urge rising within him to cry out the darkness gripping his heart, but seeing the cute girl in purple glance at him, he held the tears back with all of the emotional strength that he could muster.
6f5513a8bdbf.t: “——我记得的不多，但是——噢！那只——狗狗！我也想不起它的名字了，但它是黑白相间的。我们在看电视，它在讨吃的——然后它不见了。接着——我爸妈也不见了。在那之后，我不知怎么就觉得自己又老又胖——还很孤独。”陌生人的声音在最后越来越低。他看着地面，感到内心涌起一股冲动，想把攫住他心脏的黑暗哭出来，但看到那个穿紫色的可爱女孩朝他瞥了一眼，他用尽了所能鼓起的全部情感力量把眼泪忍了回去。

704fe5c4c983.en: Neferteri, seeming to realize the misunderstanding, spoke after. “The princess in question is our second princess, Maiara. Upon hearing the news, she decided to assist our courtroom scientist, Gabiro, and fell heart-struck once she saw you being resurrected.”
704fe5c4c983.t: 奈菲尔特丽似乎意识到了误会，随后说道：“我们说的那位公主是我们的二公主，迈阿拉。听到消息后，她决定去协助我们的宫廷科学家加比罗，在看到你被复活时，她便一见倾心了。”

70712fd6a5b0.en: An eagerly energetic voice came from the child in pink. “Nina! The four-h, and best princess! With her tru-ted mount, Fanbiro!”
70712fd6a5b0.t: 那个穿粉色衣服的孩子发出一个兴奋又充满活力的声音。“妮娜！第西个、也是最棒的公主！还有她信赖的坐骑，凡比罗！”

7225d712fa4b.en: Harry followed suit. As he got half-way into the room, he saw a two-person table with its top partly carved, looking like a three-dimensional painted wooden battlefield of sorts, containing clusters of statues on top, each forming battalions of humanoids, animals, or even monsters. By the stairs, he saw a bookcase that was filled with stuff other than books: additional figures, statues, balls of different shapes, and even additional boards that looked like pieces of battlefield. His mind suddenly clicked on a spoken foreign name. “Sorry, who’s Eiri?”
7225d712fa4b.t: 哈利也照做了。走到房间一半时，他看到一张双人桌，桌面部分被雕刻过，看起来像是某种立体的、上了色的木制战场，上面摆着一簇簇雕像，每一簇都组成一个营，有人形生物、动物，甚至还有怪物。在楼梯旁边，他看到一个书架，上面装满了书以外的东西：更多的人偶、雕像、各种形状的球，甚至还有更多看起来像战场碎片的板子。他的脑子突然对一个听到的陌生名字反应了过来。“抱歉，艾莉是谁？”

74f6e7c4b3c4.en: “Yes, sir,” Sora hid her hands behind her back. “Do you need an explanation of the room?”
74f6e7c4b3c4.t: “是的，先生。”索拉把双手藏到背后。“需要我给您介绍一下房间吗？”

76250625c766.en: Turning his attention to the broken window, he carefully peaked his head through and saw a sprawling city as far as the eyes could see. At least it looked like one, as it was a blurry mess of boxy-shaped buildings of all kinds, with a somewhat repeating color palette of white with bluish or brownish roofs that seemed to be on fire. Actually, the entire city seemed on fire. Is that fire? Wait. No. That’s a chimney! A wind blew through, bringing the smell of pastry, smoked meat, and fish. The stranger looked at the people past a grayish wall of some kind, and saw blurry humanoid figures in the distance that did not seem to be in any rush, at least most of them. Well, except a pink and white eye-catching humanoid running by herself, zig-zagging through the populace appearing to hold something.
76250625c766.t: 他把注意力转向那扇破窗户，小心翼翼地探出头去，看到一座向远方延伸、一眼望不到头的城市。至少看起来像是一座城市，因为那是一团模糊的方形建筑，形形色色，配色大致重复：白墙配蓝色或棕色的屋顶，屋顶似乎在着火。实际上，整座城市似乎都在着火。那是火吗？等等。不是。那是烟囱！一阵风吹过，带来了糕点、熏肉和鱼的香味。陌生人看向一道灰色的墙外的人群，看到远处模糊的人形身影似乎都不着急，至少大多数人是这样。嗯，除了一个粉白相间、十分抢眼的人形身影，她独自奔跑着，在人群中左躲右闪，似乎手里拿着什么东西。

7684de106b64.en: What appeared to be mere seconds later, a familiar pink humanoid, but no longer with her trusted mount, busted the doors open on the second floor. She jumped, leaning herself against the rails of the balcony, and screamed back “WHAT DADDY?”
7684de106b64.t: 似乎仅仅几秒钟后，一个熟悉的粉色人形身影——不过已经没有骑着她信赖的坐骑了——猛地撞开了二楼的门。她一跃，靠在阳台的栏杆上，大声喊回来：“干什么，爸爸？”

76c4b29d60d2.en: A heavy man, whose body shape would definitely require a seat for each buttock if he were to try to ride a train, sat in a red recliner that molded to his body…
76c4b29d60d2.t: 一个胖男人——他的体型要是去坐火车，肯定每瓣屁股都得占一个座位——坐在一张红色躺椅上，躺椅完美地贴合着他的身体……

7958640f6b22.en: “King’s—maid?” A few steps in, and Harry was already out of breath.
7958640f6b22.t: “国王的——女仆？”才上了几级台阶，哈利就已经上气不接下气了。

79731df6d7c5.en: “Huh? Really?” Itagiba exchanged a quick glare with Neferteri.
79731df6d7c5.t: “嗯？真的？”伊塔吉巴和奈菲尔特丽迅速交换了一个眼神。

7a862c03974c.en: After moving her fingers around, and speaking under her breath unintelligibly, Nina shouted back “ELEVEN!”
7a862c03974c.t: 妮娜摆弄着手指，嘴里含糊不清地嘀咕了一阵，然后喊回来：“十一个！”

7be1839b59d1.en: Itagiba shook his head up-down with a nice self-important smile, pointing at himself with his own right thumb as if he was a political candidate posing for a poster.
7be1839b59d1.t: 伊塔吉巴带着一副自以为了不起的笑容上下点了点头，用右手拇指指着自己，就像一个为海报摆拍的政客。

7cf79571fb8b.en: Is that blood? He noticed the red stains on the wall meeting a pool of darker red liquid down on the floor. His thighs were still tensed up and sore, so he used his left hand on the bookshelf, and crouched down towards it like an old person—grunting like one as well. As he went down, the stranger’s nose pierced a cloud of stagnation; a rusty, slightly pungent air entered his lungs, making him nauseous. Stiffening his face, the stranger breathed out through his nose, trying to keep the odd smell at bay. “Oh, shit, it is!” He jumped back up like a skittish cat, his heart skipping a beat, and a primordial fear striking his core. His head moved around the room furiously, searching for an enemy he did not know existed. His squinting eyes quickly followed a trail of bloodied footprints from the pool near his feet that led out of the room, stepping on what appeared to be a fallen door. What should I do? What if they killed me?
7cf79571fb8b.t: 那是血吗？他注意到墙上的红色污迹一直延伸到地上的一摊颜色更深的红色液体里。他的大腿仍然紧绷酸痛，所以他用左手扶着书架，像个老人一样蹲下去——连哼哼声都像个老人。往下蹲时，陌生人的鼻子刺入了一团滞闷的空气；一股铁锈般、略带刺鼻的气味进入肺里，让他恶心。陌生人绷紧了脸，用鼻子呼气，试图把这股怪味挡在外面。“噢，该死，真的是血！”他像只受惊的猫一样跳了起来，心跳漏了一拍，一种原始的恐惧击中了他的内心。他的头在房间里疯狂地转来转去，寻找一个他都不知道是否存在的敌人。他眯起的眼睛迅速顺着一串血脚印望去，脚印从他脚边的血泊出发，一路走出房间，踩过一扇看起来倒在地上的门。我该怎么办？万一他们杀了我呢？

7d28c8a3a422.en: Discombobulated, Harry stood there, watching the king disappear. The words “Thank you?” slipped through his mouth, followed by a bead of sweat running down his forehead, imagining himself asking her. With one slow step after the other, Harry went back to his primary goal of walking up the mountain in the shape of spiraling stairs. So I can really just ask for that? Harry imagined her small hands washing his back, exactly where an actual itch started to appear in the middle of his back, right where his hands couldn’t reach. As he reached the third floor, he saw that she was not there. The floor itself looked the exact same as the tower he got off—a small room with two doors, except this time the doors were bright blue. Stepping into the stairs going to the fourth floor, he focused on how she would look as she brushed his back—perhaps with the same embarrassment from when he touched her hands, or perhaps with a willful determination like when she ran up the stairs? But isn’t that asking too much of her? Hmm. But if the king says it’s fine, then I guess it’s fine?
7d28c8a3a422.t: 哈利晕头转向地站在那里，看着国王消失。“谢谢？”这两个字从他嘴里溜了出来，接着一颗汗珠从他额头上滑落，他想象着自己去开口问她。哈利一步一步慢慢地回到他的首要目标上：爬那座螺旋楼梯形状的山。所以我真的可以就这么开口要求？哈利想象着她的小手给他搓背，就在他背部正中间，一处真正的痒开始出现，恰好在他的手够不着的地方。到达三楼时，他发现她不在那里。这一层看起来和他下来的那座塔一模一样——一个有两扇门的小房间，只是这次门是亮蓝色的。踏上通往四楼的楼梯，他专心想着她给他刷背时会是什么样子——也许会像他摸她的手时那样害羞，也许会像她跑上楼时那样意志坚决？可这是不是对她要求太多了？嗯。不过既然国王说没问题，那我想就没问题吧？

7ea8dcb0fb6d.en: Harry bit his cheeks, looking at the odd time-keeping instrument. Maybe I am just remembering wrongly, then. With a slightly strained smile, he looked back at Sora. “Thank you for showing me all of this!”
7ea8dcb0fb6d.t: 哈利咬着脸颊，看着那个古怪的计时仪器。那也许只是我记错了。他带着略显勉强的笑容回头看向索拉。“谢谢你给我看这些！”

7f479e4c029a.en: Laughing out loud at the white bright light on the TV, the heavy man finished gulping down the beer, and with a lazy fling, he threw the bottle aside, careless to look, or bother where it would land; the bottle did not make a noise. Instead, it vanished into the darkness not soon after leaving his hands.
7f479e4c029a.t: 胖男人对着电视上明亮的白光哈哈大笑，喝完了啤酒，懒洋洋地一甩，把瓶子扔到一边，根本不在乎它会落到哪里；瓶子没有发出声音。相反，它刚离开他的手不久，就消失在了黑暗中。

80907259a3ce.en: As the stars disappeared from his vision, a memory appeared in the soft darkness of his vision; it was himself, seated in something comfortable, reddish in color, but he could not remember the details other than knowing it was a recliner.
80907259a3ce.t: 当金星从视线中消失时，一段记忆出现在他视野中柔和的黑暗里；那是他自己，坐在某个舒服的、红色的东西上，但除了知道那是一张躺椅之外，他想不起任何细节。

80e433984f15.en: “Your corpse was discovered in the slums by the guards. We were aware you would lose a few memories based on your advanced state of decay, yet it is unfortunate to hear that you lost far more than the average person would.” Neferteri spoke like a president on live TV reading from a teleprompter—rehearsed, slowly, clearly, but kinda emotionless.
80e433984f15.t: “你的尸体是卫兵在贫民窟里发现的。根据你腐烂的程度，我们知道你会失去一些记忆，但遗憾的是，你失去的远比普通人多。”奈菲尔特丽说话的样子就像总统在电视直播里照着提词器念稿——经过排练，缓慢、清晰，但有点缺乏感情。

81df56355af1.en: Nina hurled herself to stand on top of the rails, and like a cheerleader, she began making weird hand signs with her hands and arms. The first was a rectangle shape above her head. She then said out loud “H!” The second transformed into a triangle shape, and then she said “A!” The third and fourth were a hand wave that went up, then down to the right in a forty-five-degree angle for a bit, then halfway back horizontally, up to the middle, then right horizontally.
81df56355af1.t: 妮娜一跃站到栏杆顶上，像个啦啦队员一样，开始用手和胳膊比画出奇怪的手势。第一个是举过头顶的长方形。然后她大声喊道：“H！”第二个变成了一个三角形，接着她喊道：“A！”第三个和第四个是一个手势：先向上挥，然后以四十五度角向右下方挥一点，再水平地往回挥一半，向上到中间，然后向右水平挥。

81ea1028b64a.en: “Well, what do you know?” The towering man in white cape let go of the stranger’s weak-ass grip. His question felt like a blunt weapon by the quick timing, but his intonation seemed pretty curious about it, rather than just feeling rude.
81ea1028b64a.t: “好吧，那你知道些什么？”那个披着白斗篷的高大男人松开了陌生人那软绵绵的手。这个问题来得太快，像一记钝器，但他的语调听起来更多是好奇，而不只是失礼。

865151ffe148.en: Itagiba chuckled out loudly. “Ah—ah! Oooh! That’s great! I need to use that one someday.”
865151ffe148.t: 伊塔吉巴大声笑了出来。“啊——啊！哦！太棒了！我哪天得用一下这招。”

875fe750d7f6.en: Us? Harry’s mind searched its entire catalog of words, but nothing came up for it. Humans, yes, but not Naked Bruntos.
875fe750d7f6.t: 我们？哈利的脑子把整个词汇库都搜了一遍，却什么也没找到。人类，有，但裸布伦托斯，没有。

8a36816ed3ba.en: Letting out a faint exasperated sigh when the stones stopped rattling, Sora continued, bowing, “I’m sorry for my rudeness, sir Harry. This type of fost lamp is not meant to be hung, so it does not come with a cable. We do light it up for you every evening—” Noticing Harry’s puppy eyes, Sora continued. “But I can show you right now if you would like.”
8a36816ed3ba.t: 等石头不再晃动，索拉轻轻地、无奈地叹了口气，鞠了一躬，继续说道：“请原谅我的失礼，哈利先生。这种福斯特灯不是用来吊挂的，所以不带链子。我们每天晚上都会为您点亮它——”注意到哈利那双小狗般的眼睛，索拉接着说，“不过如果您愿意，我现在就可以演示给您看。”

8b28647be40e.en: “Hey! Come on down!” A friendly voice caught his attention amongst the rustles of the city’s noises. Following the source of the voice, he saw the walls with a beautiful splash of flowery colors hugging its insides, separating the city from a green field with a large boxy castle in the middle. Right below him, he saw a patch of what looked like a splash of blood contrasting the beautiful green, with three adult humanoids in blue and golden hues standing around it. Meanwhile, zooming randomly around like a headless chicken, a small pink humanoid on top of a large, round black thing rushed by the purple-hair humanoid, nearly crashing against it. He could not make any details of what was happening, but he clearly heard the echo of a child's laughter, shrieks of a distressed bird, and a girly, somewhat angry, voice that screamed back “CUT IT OUT, NINA!”
8b28647be40e.t: “嘿！下来吧！”在城市的嘈杂声中，一个友善的声音引起了他的注意。顺着声音的来源望去，他看到那道墙内侧环绕着一片美丽缤纷的花色，把城市和一片中央矗立着一座方形大城堡的绿地隔开。就在他正下方，他看到一块看起来像血迹的东西，与美丽的绿色形成鲜明对比，三个穿着蓝金色调衣服的成年人形身影站在周围。与此同时，一个小小的粉色人形身影骑在一个巨大的、圆滚滚的黑色东西上，像无头苍蝇一样随意乱窜，从那个紫发的人形身影身边冲过，差点撞上她。他看不清发生了什么，但清楚地听到了孩子笑声的回音、一只鸟惊慌的尖叫，还有一个有点生气的女孩声音喊道：“别闹了，妮娜！”

8c804f29fad3.en: A sudden gleam appeared in the stranger’s eyes, focusing as much attention as he could muster to hear what Neferteri was about to say.
8c804f29fad3.t: 陌生人的眼睛里突然闪过一道光，他集中全部注意力，想听奈菲尔特丽接下来要说什么。

8fdb4b36578a.en: “Morning, Sora! Yep, that’s him alright. He’s Harry by the way.” Itagiba gave off a cool smile, noticing where Sora was actually looking.
8fdb4b36578a.t: “早上好，索拉！没错，就是他。顺便说一句，他叫哈利。”伊塔吉巴露出一个酷酷的笑容，注意到索拉实际上在看哪里。

92f5c8042d0e.en: Closing the odd-looking toilet, she cradled the fost lamp with her both hands. “Yes sir. Is there anything else you would like help with, sir Harry? The tub is ready for you.” Sora waved her hand towards the tub in the back of the bathroom, patiently waiting to strip Harry from his Bagarisa musk.
92f5c8042d0e.t: 她合上那个样子古怪的马桶，用双手捧着福斯特灯。“是的，先生。您还需要我帮什么忙吗，哈利先生？浴缸已经为您准备好了。”索拉朝浴室后面的浴缸挥了挥手，耐心地等着把哈利身上的巴加里萨麝香洗掉。

95e89f96fc9e.en: “Sora, he’s talking about your Darfaries vein.” Itagiba tapped Harry on the shoulder. “Man, your eyes are really that bad, huh?”
95e89f96fc9e.t: “索拉，他说的是你的达尔法里斯脉。”伊塔吉巴拍了拍哈利的肩膀。“伙计，你的眼睛真有那么差啊？”

966024760337.en: “Yo! You got a name?” The towering man in a blue fish-scale-covered tank top stood up in front of him, giving him his hand for a shake, and blocking the way to the cute girl with long purple hair. The amount of gold-colored clothing, plus the bluish crystals on his neck, gave him the appeal of a grandiose figure. His eyes sized the stranger’s overall body thickness, and total lack of sex appeal—or clothes for that matter.
966024760337.t: “哟！你有名字吗？”那个穿着覆盖蓝色鱼鳞背心的高大男人站到他面前，向他伸出手要握手，挡住了通往那个紫色长发可爱女孩的路。他身上那么多金色的衣饰，加上脖子上那些蓝色的晶石，让他看起来气派非凡。他的眼睛估量着陌生人那整体的厚实身材，以及完全没有性吸引力——更别提连衣服都没穿。

9675dbb19b13.en: “Ew. I was not the one who requested such a corpulent thing,” Eori’s cold-sounding voice was elegant like her mother’s, yet just as blunt as her father’s.
9675dbb19b13.t: “咦。我可没要这么一个肥嘟嘟的东西。”埃奥丽冷冰冰的声音像她母亲一样优雅，却又像她父亲一样直白。

97f9dd38b387.en: Meanwhile, Harry was looking at her cutesy hand laid out in front of him. Feeling a sense of peer pressure from behind, plus his own desires, he gulped as he carefully held it with both hands. It was slender, but just as warm, and comforting as Princess Eori’s. Still being careful, he touched the Darfaries vein; its red bumpiness was warmer than the rest of her hand, and had a certain toughness to it, but as his finger pressed slightly on it, it gave way to its squishiness.
97f9dd38b387.t: 与此同时，哈利看着那只摊在他面前的可爱的手。感受到身后传来的某种同伴压力，加上他自己的欲望，他咽了口唾沫，小心翼翼地用双手握住它。那只手纤细，却和埃奥丽公主的一样温暖、令人安心。他依然小心翼翼地摸了摸那条达尔法里斯脉；那红色的凸起比她手上其他地方更温暖，有一定的韧性，但当他的手指稍微一按，它就软软地陷了下去。

981cbb3c560d.en: Chapter II subchapter 2: a man lies on a table under a window, one arm raised, in a room spattered with blood.
981cbb3c560d.t: 第二章第 2 小节：一个男人躺在窗下的桌子上，一只手臂举起，房间里溅满了血。

983c2e2501e6.t: 那道光停止了飞驰，下一秒就像一门光炮一样击中了他，夺走了他的感官。

9927a95254b6.en: Itagiba let out a good hum. “Hmmm—you mentioned that before—what is that? Actually, never mind. Do me a solid and write down the recipe for Eiri, okay? I want to be surprised!”
9927a95254b6.t: 伊塔吉巴发出一声满意的哼声。“嗯——你之前提过——那到底是什么？其实，算了。帮我个忙，把菜谱写给艾莉，好吗？我想要个惊喜！”

99caa4d9a44d.en: Trying to keep some distance from the Bagarisa musk coming from Harry, Sora, standing at the door, placed her hand on the comfortable, leathery grayish-green couch. “Sir Harry—this is a couch—and you would use it to sit and read books and—” Sora trailed off mid-sentence, realizing Harry was looking elsewhere.
99caa4d9a44d.t: 为了和哈利身上的巴加里萨麝香保持一点距离，站在门口的索拉把手放在那张舒适的灰绿色皮沙发上。“哈利先生——这是沙发——您可以坐在上面看书，还有——”索拉话说到一半停了下来，意识到哈利在看别的地方。

9a2d4884e5df.en: The stranger looked at himself, his skin completely fine. Plus he still had all limbs attached. But I am fine—Were they protecting me instead? But from what? What is this place anyway? Hmm?
9a2d4884e5df.t: 陌生人看了看自己，皮肤完好无损。而且四肢都还连在身上。可我没事啊——难道他们是在保护我？可防的是什么？这到底是什么地方？嗯？

9bf7cf73e81e.en: “That’s what she wants. So? Wanna marry her?” Itagiba cracked a wide smirk as his face was still right by the stranger’s, carefully watching for a response.
9bf7cf73e81e.t: “这就是她想要的。怎么样？想娶她吗？”伊塔吉巴咧嘴露出一个大大的坏笑，他的脸仍然紧挨着陌生人的脸，仔细观察着他的反应。

9d57d62b8d3e.en: “—Dear. Hold. We need a name.” Neferteri softly spoke, calling to her husband as he was about to herd the stranger away. Meanwhile, the stranger smelled his hand, frowning as he noticed his nose had grown accustomed to his own musk.
9d57d62b8d3e.t: “——亲爱的。等等。我们需要一个名字。”奈菲尔特丽轻声叫住正要把陌生人赶走的丈夫。与此同时，陌生人闻了闻自己的手，皱起眉头，发现自己的鼻子已经习惯了自身的麝香味。

9e901329f96e.en: On what would be just another taco-beer-burp-taco-beer-taco-beer-fart-taco-beer loop, the white light began flickering the moment he was practicing playing his built-in smelly trombone. With blinking eyes, as if he had just come out of a long daydream, the corpulent man looked around; darkness to his left, darkness to his right, and darkness swallowing the backside. Everything around him was nothing but darkness. A feeling of being somewhere supposedly familiar, but yet feeling completely foreign gripped his insides; it was not another fart.
9e901329f96e.t: 就在这本该又是一个“塔可—啤酒—打嗝—塔可—啤酒—塔可—啤酒—放屁—塔可—啤酒”的循环里，就在他正练习吹奏他那支自带的臭长号时，白光开始闪烁。这个胖男人眨着眼，仿佛刚从一场漫长的白日梦中醒来，环顾四周；左边一片黑暗，右边一片黑暗，身后也被黑暗吞没。他周围的一切都只剩下黑暗。一种身处某个本该熟悉、却又完全陌生的地方的感觉攫住了他的五脏六腑；这次不是又一个屁。

a020a2c8f3c0.en: Harry used his hand to cover his eyes, stepping back from whatever Sora was doing. Soon after, the lamp light began to dwindle, including its steam output, leaving a faint bioluminescence. “WOW! That was cool! Huh—are the stones smaller now?”
a020a2c8f3c0.t: 哈利用手捂住眼睛，从索拉正在做的事旁边退开。没过多久，灯光开始减弱，蒸汽也随之变少，只留下微弱的生物荧光。“哇！太酷了！嗯——石头现在变小了吗？”

a0b85159a429.en: Harry smiled, “Actually, yes, it’s just—some stuff looks weird to me. Like that. How's that a lamp?” Harry approached the supposed lamp, and picked it up. The top of the lamp had a hole about the size of a quarter, with two stones inside that had a glimmering radiance to them when inspected up close. How do you turn this on? Harry felt like there was something missing. “Don’t you have to, like, plug it or some—” He looked at the bottom of the lamp, rattling the stones inside as they clashed against the glass top. “There's no cable either—that’s weird.”
a0b85159a429.t: 哈利笑了。“其实，知道，只是——有些东西在我看来很奇怪。比如那个。那怎么会是灯？”哈利走近那盏所谓的灯，把它拿了起来。灯顶上有一个大约二十五美分硬币大小的洞，里面有两块石头，凑近看时闪烁着微光。这东西怎么打开？哈利觉得少了点什么。“难道不用插个电什么的——”他看了看灯底，石头在里面晃来晃去，撞在玻璃灯罩上哐啷作响。“也没有电线——真奇怪。”

a1527a8442fa.en: Meanwhile, Harry opened another drawer by the sink to put the timekeeper back, when he saw another familiar thing in purpose, but foreigner in aesthetic: a wooden toothbrush with red bristles, looking as if the bristles were pulled out of the back of some animal. By it, there was a fancy green porcelain jar with a greenish concoction inside that looked syrupy. Harry, placing the timekeeper back in a boxy wooden frame also inside the same drawer, grabbed the toothbrush, dipped it into the syrup, and brought it to his nose. A strong, but pleasant refreshing mint tickled it, then came the notes of green tea, and something citrusy about it. That’s an interesting toothpaste. Brushing a hearty amount of the syrup from the somewhat hard bristles on his tongue, it initially tasted something akin to nutmeg, then he felt as if someone punched him in the mouth. Ow fuck!—an explosion of flavor cocktail was so intense that most of his tongue grew numb. “Argh! Ow!”
a1527a8442fa.t: 与此同时，哈利拉开水槽旁的另一个抽屉，想把泰姆基珀放回去，却看到了另一样用途熟悉、外观却很陌生的东西：一把红色刷毛的木牙刷，那刷毛看起来像是从某种动物背上拔下来的。旁边有一个精美的绿色瓷罐，里面装着一种看起来像糖浆的绿色调和物。哈利把泰姆基珀放回同一个抽屉里的一个方形木框中，拿起牙刷，蘸了蘸糖浆，凑到鼻子前。一股强烈却宜人的清凉薄荷味挠着他的鼻子，接着是绿茶的气息，还有某种柑橘味。这牙膏还挺有意思。他用那有点硬的刷毛把一大坨糖浆刷到舌头上，起初尝起来有点像肉豆蔻，然后他感觉就像有人一拳打在他嘴上。哎哟，操！——一场强烈得惊人的风味鸡尾酒爆炸开来，让他大半个舌头都麻了。“啊！哎哟！”

a28cbd9d11f6.en: “I—I—guess so?” A strained cutesy voice came out of Sora, feeling the pressure, and Bagarisa musk coming from Harry as she stepped closer, slowly extending one of her slightly shaking hands towards him.
a28cbd9d11f6.t: “我——我——我想可以吧？”索拉发出一个勉强的可爱声音，她感到了压力，还有从哈利身上传来的巴加里萨麝香味，她走近一步，慢慢地把一只微微发抖的手伸向他。

a3f07d51cdae.t: 水龙头不是这样用的吧？哈利看着索拉，她仔细地看着福斯特灯快灌到一半时，用尽全力压下把手。接着，她取出漏斗，用毛巾擦干收好，然后从同一个抽屉里拿出一个玻璃罐，里面装满了白色的细颗粒——巧的是，罐子上也自带一个几乎和福斯特灯的洞一样大的漏斗。“那是盐吗？”哈利看着白色颗粒噗噗地落进水里，沉向底部。

a46a79e3e08f.en: She instead averted her eyes from him, fumbling her hands in front of an open blue door. “W–welcome to your guest room, sir Harry! I apologize for not bringing you proper clothes. Is there anything else you need?” Flushing red, but not as intensely as before, Sora peeked again at him, then back at the ground in front of him.
a46a79e3e08f.t: 她却移开了视线，在一扇敞开的蓝色门前摆弄着双手。“欢——欢迎来到您的客房，哈利先生！很抱歉没能给您拿来合适的衣服。您还需要什么吗？”索拉脸红了，但没有之前那么厉害，她又偷看了他一眼，然后又低头看着他面前的地面。

a4a03a8d24fa.en: Nina, with her hand on her ears and somehow balancing herself purely on her stomach, nodded, then put up one finger with her left-hand, and four with the right-hand “TWENTY-SEVEN RAKUJAS!”
a4a03a8d24fa.t: 妮娜双手捂着耳朵，不知怎么全靠肚子保持着平衡，她点点头，然后左手竖起一根手指，右手竖起四根。“二十七个拉库贾！”

a4f2733c5b89.en: “Arrrrgggghhhh—hmph.” A loud burp nearly turned into vomit as this man’s stomach struggled with another horde of pig slop coming down his esophagus, but as soon as his stomach relented, he shoved down the last bite into his food hole. The saucy taco spilled down the sides of his mouth, then down his chin, and dripped on his chest.
a4f2733c5b89.t: “呃呃呃呃——哼。”一个响亮的嗝差点变成呕吐，这个男人的胃正在和又一大批顺着食道涌下的猪食搏斗，但胃一认输，他就把最后一口塞进了自己的饭洞。酱汁满满的塔可从他嘴角溢出来，顺着下巴流下，滴在胸口。

a756a1f83cc6.en: Neferteri softly smiled. “Dear, you do not recall anything about your persona? Not even a name?”
a756a1f83cc6.t: 奈菲尔特丽温柔地笑了笑。“亲爱的，你不记得任何关于你自己的事吗？连名字都不记得？”

a795d3f207fc.en: Stating in a lower, mischievous voice, the king spoke into Harry’s ear. “Take a peek at the rails going up.”
a795d3f207fc.t: 国王用一种更低沉、调皮的声音对着哈利的耳朵说：“往上看看楼梯扶手那边。”

a9802f0ea018.en: The stranger, feeling his sense of balance off, like he just got out of a rollercoaster, slowly stood up with his boxers in hand. Leaning his weight against the table, he put his feet through the holes, and started pulling the cloth up his legs. It felt quite comfortable at first with its higher quality breathable cotton rubbing on his skin, but as it got up closer to the waist, it certainly felt like it was not meant for him, leaving a clear imprint of his privates up front, and a slightly scratchy sensation on the stretchy fabric that rubbed on his waist.
a9802f0ea018.t: 陌生人觉得自己的平衡感有些失调，就像刚下过山车一样，他拿着短裤慢慢站起来。他把重心靠在桌子上，把脚伸进裤腿，开始把布料往腿上拉。起初，那更高品质的透气棉布摩擦着他的皮肤，感觉相当舒服，但越往腰上拉，就越明显地感觉到它不是为他准备的：前面清晰地勒出他私处的轮廓，弹性布料摩擦着腰部，还有点刺痒。

aa5231c4ce15.en: Looking as if someone jumped-scared her, Sora quickly looked at her hands and arms, then at her clothing—appearing as if she was performing some form of senseless postmodern choreography. With her blush waning, she slightly furrowed her brow and tilted her neck. “I’m sorry, sir Harry, but where am I bleeding?”
aa5231c4ce15.t: 索拉就像被人吓了一跳，赶紧看看自己的双手和胳膊，然后又看看自己的衣服——看起来就像在表演某种毫无意义的后现代舞蹈。她的红晕渐渐褪去，微微皱起眉头，歪了歪脖子。“对不起，哈利先生，可我哪里在流血？”

ac670eeefbe7.en: Itagiba waved his hand towards the stairs to let Harry walk up first. “King-maid. I will ask her to stop by and say hi. I mean, she would do that anyway.”
ac670eeefbe7.t: 伊塔吉巴朝楼梯挥挥手，让哈利先上去。“国王女仆。我会让她过来打个招呼。我是说，反正她也会这么做的。”

ad7a95acdc1d.en: He looked at his parents’ faces, but he could not see their expressions, or even how they looked. He looked back at the dog, but he was gone, and so were his parents. He now sat by himself, in a small apartment, looking much older than what he currently was.
ad7a95acdc1d.t: 他看向父母的脸，却看不到他们的表情，甚至看不清他们的样子。他回头看那只狗，可它不见了，他的父母也不见了。现在他独自坐在一间小公寓里，看起来比他现在老得多。

aee664a623c7.en: The stranger looked back and forth between the king and queen. Both were anxiously waiting for his response. He then glanced towards the beautiful princess, Eori, apparently busy looking at the flowers hugging the castle walls. I guess I can’t say no to this? They saved me after all. A nervous grin appeared on him as he imagined another princess in the same vein as the purple-haired one. “Yes!” the stranger said, with no further hesitation.
aee664a623c7.t: 陌生人在国王和王后之间来回看着。两人都焦急地等着他的回答。他又瞥了一眼那位美丽的公主埃奥丽，她显然正忙着看城堡墙边的花。我想我没法拒绝吧？毕竟是他们救了我。他想象着另一位和这位紫发公主差不多的公主，脸上露出一个紧张的笑容。“愿意！”陌生人说道，没有再犹豫。

b11c2d576cb0.en: “Shhh—she’s fine, see?” The king smiled, releasing the stranger. “CAN YOU GIVE HIM A NAME?” Itagiba loudly spoke to Nina.
b11c2d576cb0.t: “嘘——她没事，看见没？”国王笑着放开了陌生人。“你能给他起个名字吗？”伊塔吉巴大声对妮娜说。

b1fc09a9585d.en: “Hahaha—that’s what you get,” Itagiba busted out a belly laugh, with Eori, the princess in purple, showing a pleasurable grin on her face as she held back a soft laughter.
b1fc09a9585d.t: “哈哈哈——活该。”伊塔吉巴捧腹大笑，那位穿紫色的公主埃奥丽脸上也露出愉快的笑容，忍着轻笑。

b29a03784e4a.en: The stranger opened his burning eyes to a blinding light, barely recognizing a blurry white ceiling above him. The stranger felt the blood pumping in his veins, a steady heartbeat in his chest that pricked his extremities, and his back uncomfortably resting against something hard that felt slightly moist, sticky.
b29a03784e4a.t: 陌生人睁开灼痛的双眼，面对的是刺眼的光，勉强认出头顶上一片模糊的白色天花板。陌生人感觉到血液在血管里奔流，胸口稳定的心跳让四肢末端一阵阵发麻，背部不舒服地靠在某个坚硬、略带潮湿和黏腻的东西上。

b2e11d1a0fc4.en: With his heart rate up, beads of sweat formed on Harry’s forehead. His body looked as if it was climbing a mountain, but in reality he was just finishing the first flight of stairs.
b2e11d1a0fc4.t: 哈利的心跳加快，额头上冒出了汗珠。他的身体看起来就像在爬山，但实际上他只是刚爬完第一段楼梯。

b41507ee13ec.en: The screen was a thin bezel TV that only showed a white bright light, with a constant noise, like what an old CRT used to make, but instead of a single high-pitched, ear-piercing noise, it sounded closer to heavy rain on a roof. However, if you paid close attention, it kinda felt like you could pick out a voice in a sea of voices, or an instrument within a thousand simultaneous orchestras.
b41507ee13ec.t: 那块屏幕是一台窄边框电视，只显示一片明亮的白光，伴随着持续不断的噪音，就像老式显像管电视会发出的那种，只不过不是单一刺耳的高频噪音，听起来更像是屋顶上的瓢泼大雨。然而，如果你仔细听，会觉得似乎能在声音的海洋里分辨出某一个声音，或在一千支同时演奏的管弦乐队中分辨出某一件乐器。

b7e3035f1be4.en: Squinting his eyes hard, he tried to make out the room he was in. He saw a large—maybe broken—window, and a large splash of something red against the wall. Bookcases to the left and right of the window, and other wooden cabinets and a sink spread through the other walls—it had a strong utilitarian, doctor’s office appeal to it, especially with the table he was sitting at being dead-center in the room—the only thing it was missing were cringy posters of pharmaceutical companies trying to push medicine into patients, and a call-a-nurse button.
b7e3035f1be4.t: 他使劲眯起眼睛，想看清自己所在的房间。他看到一扇很大的——也许是破了的——窗户，墙上还有一大片红色的东西。窗户左右两边是书架，其他几面墙边散布着木柜和一个水槽——整个房间带着浓浓的实用主义、医生诊室般的味道，尤其是他坐着的那张桌子正好位于房间正中央——唯一缺的就是制药公司那些想把药推销给病人的尴尬海报，以及一个呼叫护士的按钮。

b8c23973dccd.en: Itagiba hugged the stranger from the side, ignoring the Bagarisa musk coming from him; he spoke with a straight face right up close to his. “You can bug Gabiro for the details when he’s back! He’s like the smartest—smartass too—scientist in the block! But you still haven’t asked why we resurrected you! So let me tell you straight—we want you to marry one of our princesses—even if you stink like a Bagarisa.”
b8c23973dccd.t: 伊塔吉巴从侧面搂住陌生人，无视他身上散发的巴加里萨麝香味；他板着脸，凑得很近地对他说：“等加比罗回来，你可以去缠着他问细节！他是这一片最聪明的——也是最爱耍嘴皮子的——科学家！不过你还没问我们为什么要把你复活呢！所以让我直说吧——我们想让你娶我们的一位公主——哪怕你臭得像头巴加里萨。”

bc30f86b7495.en: “Yes, sir.” Sora put away the odd-looking saltshaker. Meanwhile, the mostly dissolved grains of salt reached the stones in the bottom, making white light sparkle across it, and forming small bubbles. As the salt-rich water further enveloped the whitish stones, the sparkles of light began joining together into a dim light that grew steadier.
bc30f86b7495.t: “是的，先生。”索拉把那个样子古怪的盐罐收了起来。与此同时，大部分已经溶解的盐粒到达了底部的石头，让白光在石头上闪烁，形成小小的气泡。随着富含盐分的水进一步包裹住那些发白的石头，闪烁的光点开始汇聚成一团昏暗的光，并越来越稳定。

bd47d190f680.en: “That’s my girl!” The king clapped with energy, of which Neferteri and Eori did not share.
bd47d190f680.t: “这才是我的好女儿！”国王起劲地鼓起掌来，而奈菲尔特丽和埃奥丽并没有这份热情。

bd7e15b70651.en: The TV, with its last flickering light, finally gave its last burst. The darkness, that forever waited patiently, now finally had the opportunity to strike.
bd7e15b70651.t: 电视随着最后一下闪烁，终于迸发出最后一道光。那永远耐心等待着的黑暗，终于等到了出击的机会。

be7c074ee4d7.en: Harry looked around the room and saw a few wooden cabinets and two square containers—one with a lid that looked like a trashcan, and another that looked like a laundry basket. “Eh—I think I get the rest. Thanks again, Sora!”
be7c074ee4d7.t: 哈利环顾房间，看到几个木柜和两个方形容器——一个带盖子，看起来像垃圾桶，另一个看起来像洗衣篮。“呃——我想剩下的我都明白了。再次谢谢你，索拉！”

c0768cd3ac2f.en: A suppressed girly moan came out of the maid, Sora, while her body slightly shivered.
c0768cd3ac2f.t: 女仆索拉发出一声压抑的、少女般的呻吟，身体微微一颤。

c0b3c9202afe.en: What is this place? He kept squinting as he looked for something familiar, but there was nothing amongst the pile of stuff thrown all over the place that hinted at it.
c0b3c9202afe.t: 这是什么地方？他一直眯着眼睛寻找熟悉的东西，但在扔得到处都是的一堆杂物中，没有任何东西给出提示。

c1e4fb287773.en: Looking towards the back of the room, Harry saw a window, and right below it, a neatly set, comfortable-looking single person bed. To the left of the room there was another normal-looking door, closed, and beside it a large painting of a guy, looking like an older version of Itagiba, fishing from the clouds while being pulled by an animal that looked like a horse. Below that painting, there was a desk with ink in five different hues: yellow, red, green, blue, and black, plus the same nari stone he had seen before, but now they were individually laid out neatly below the inks. “Can I ask what that is?” Harry’s eyes noticed a blur of a glass-and-wood lamp-looking thing with two whitish stones inside resting on top of a nightstand. “They are like—everywhere.”
c1e4fb287773.t: 哈利望向房间里面，看到一扇窗户，窗户正下方是一张铺得整整齐齐、看起来很舒服的单人床。房间左边还有一扇看起来很普通的门，关着，旁边挂着一幅大画，画上是一个看起来像老年版伊塔吉巴的男人，被一种看起来像马的动物拉着，正从云端钓鱼。画下面有一张书桌，上面放着五种不同颜色的墨水：黄、红、绿、蓝、黑，还有他之前见过的那种纳里石，不过现在它们被一块块整齐地摆放在墨水下面。“我能问一下那是什么吗？”哈利的眼睛注意到床头柜上有一个模糊的、像玻璃和木头做成的灯一样的东西，里面装着两块发白的石头。“它们好像——到处都是。”

c2b615a129bb.en: The other floor below was the exact same, except there were faint bloody footprints from the bottom stairs going into the main door. The stranger, feeling as if he was being peer pressured, even though there were no peers around him, stepped closer to the door, only to hear a constant beating rhythm—like an eagerly quickening clap. His hand clenched to a fist, ready to knock at the door, but looking at the bloodied footprints, his face clenched as well, making his hand avoid the mysteriousness of that side quest.
c2b615a129bb.t: 再下一层也完全一样，只是有一串淡淡的血脚印从楼梯底部延伸进主门。陌生人觉得自己像是受到了同伴压力，尽管周围根本没有同伴，他走近那扇门，却听到一阵持续不断、有节奏的敲击声——像急切而越来越快的拍打。他的手攥成拳头，准备敲门，但看着那些血脚印，他的脸也绷紧了，让他的手避开了这个神秘的支线任务。

c58f4746ab79.en: The darker skinned lady came closer to the towering men and put her hand on his left shoulder. “Honey, let him speak.” Her eyes glared at the stranger as well, appearing to analyze everything he said, or did, maybe even how quickly he was breathing.
c58f4746ab79.t: 皮肤较黑的女士走近那个高大的男人，把手搭在他的左肩上。“亲爱的，让他说。”她的眼睛也盯着陌生人，似乎在分析他说的每一句话、做的每一件事，也许连他呼吸的快慢都不放过。

c6be0c4d3e8e.en: “But Mom! This fatso looks like him!” Nina had a sweet, innocent tone to her childish voice, but her devious grin contrasted it like day and night.
c6be0c4d3e8e.t: “可是妈妈！这个胖子就是长得像他嘛！”妮娜稚嫩的声音里带着甜美天真的语气，但她狡黠的笑容却与之形成天壤之别。

c787ee3df9f9.en: “Yeah. She takes care of the maids, and the accounting of the kingdom,” Itagiba replied without thinking, as if this answer has been given to people many times.
c787ee3df9f9.t: “对。她管女仆们，还管王国的账目。”伊塔吉巴想都没想就回答了，仿佛这个答案已经对很多人说过很多遍。

c788c7632db9.en: Marry one of our princesses. Itagiba’s words echoed in the stranger’s brain, unable to be processed, not because he couldn’t, but rather he never thought those words would be spoken. His brain, stuck on a BSOD, did not give any further instructions, so he was stuck in a paralyzed blinking motion until a ding occurred when his brain finally rebooted. His jaw dropped, and he immediately turned his head towards Eori’s beautiful face—his blue eyes widened so much it was about to fall from his eye sockets.
c788c7632db9.t: 娶我们的一位公主。伊塔吉巴的话在陌生人的脑子里回荡，无法被处理，不是因为他处理不了，而是他从没想过会有人说出这样的话。他的大脑卡在了蓝屏上，没有给出任何进一步的指令，所以他一直卡在一种瘫痪般的眨眼动作里，直到大脑终于重启时“叮”的一声响起。他的下巴掉了下来，立刻把头转向埃奥丽那张美丽的脸——他的蓝眼睛瞪得那么大，几乎要从眼眶里掉出来。

c84205aca9a1.en: The stranger felt like he was punched in the liver when Eori said ew, but that was only the start of it. With the rest of her eloquent speech, he felt like she, emotionally speaking, had just given him a fatality combo, akin to the gruesome, spine-ripping ones found in popular combat games. He could not muster anything to reply back, for he also felt locked in place by Itagiba’s strong arm around his neck.
c84205aca9a1.t: 埃奥丽说出“咦”的时候，陌生人感觉自己像被一拳打在了肝上，但这只是开始。伴随着她其余那番雄辩的话，他觉得她在情感上刚刚给了他一套终结连招，就像那些热门格斗游戏里血腥的扯脊椎招式一样。他想不出任何话来回应，因为他也被伊塔吉巴那只搂在他脖子上的强壮手臂锁在了原地。

c8acb1ac8836.en: A heavy man, whose body shape would definitely require a seat for each buttock if he were to try to ride a train, sat in a red recliner that molded to his body perfectly, as if he had used it for an eternity. Behind thick square glasses, dirty with his own oily grimy skin, his eyes looked fervently at a white screen; no different than a deer looking at a truck’s headlight, moments away from experiencing the thrill of sudden change of momentum.
c8acb1ac8836.t: 一个胖男人——他的体型要是去坐火车，肯定每瓣屁股都得占一个座位——坐在一张红色躺椅上，躺椅完美地贴合着他的身体，仿佛他已经坐了一辈子。在沾满他自己油腻污垢的厚厚方框眼镜后面，他的眼睛狂热地盯着一块白色屏幕；就像一头盯着卡车大灯的鹿，片刻之后就要体验动量突变的刺激。

ca3d4e4bd06e.en: “Dear, please tell us everything you might remember. You can trust us.” She extended her hand as well, briefly meeting the stranger’s. “For I am Neferteri Sanbi Royal, the queen of Sanbi, and this is the king, Itagiba Sanbi Royal.”
ca3d4e4bd06e.t: “亲爱的，请把你可能记得的一切都告诉我们。你可以信任我们。”她也伸出手，和陌生人的手短暂地握了一下。“因为我是奈菲尔特丽·桑比·罗亚尔，桑比的女王，这位是国王，伊塔吉巴·桑比·罗亚尔。”

cb1d77f5ab71.en: Sora, looking at the tip of her middle and ring fingers, took note of the red vein-like pattern that bumped out of her virgin skin. She carefully watched the vein appear from the tip of her fingers towards the back of the hand where it merged into a larger vein as it continued down her forearm. She pulled on her black sleeve, revealing the same larger red vein-like thing going all the way up her forearm, getting as thick as a pencil with additional branches coming off the large vein.
cb1d77f5ab71.t: 索拉看着自己中指和无名指的指尖，注意到那从她洁白无瑕的皮肤上凸起的红色静脉状纹路。她仔细地看着那条“静脉”从指尖一直延伸到手背，在那里汇入一条更粗的“静脉”，继续顺着前臂往下延伸。她拉起黑色的袖子，露出同样粗大的红色静脉状纹路一路沿着前臂向上，变得像铅笔一样粗，还从这条粗静脉上分出更多的枝杈。

cb34b7f0d313.en: The stranger clapped as well, trying to follow the same enthusiastic fatherly energy, but he was offbeat, for his concentration was also divided in noticing how the queen and Eori behaved indifferently to this spectacle.
cb34b7f0d313.t: 陌生人也跟着鼓掌，试图模仿那份热情的父爱，但他没跟上节拍，因为他的注意力也分了一部分去留意王后和埃奥丽对这场表演表现得多么漠不关心。

cb3f2af9ecd6.en: “Yes, sir. Right now it is Sunnolow, which is why that half timehunk is lit up. When the other half lights up instead, it will be Sunnohigh. Please make yourself at home—and, sir Harry—please enjoy your bath!” Sora ended with a tone as if she was pleading her case to a policeman, right before being arrested. “—there is plenty of time until Monnalow!” Sora, holding her nose away from Harry, looked away, fidgeting with her hands, ashamed of what she was trying to say.
cb3f2af9ecd6.t: “是的，先生。现在是苏诺洛，所以那半个 timehunk 是亮的。等另一半亮起来，就是苏诺海了。请把这里当自己家——还有，哈利先生——请好好享受您的洗澡时光！”索拉说最后这句时的语气，就像在被捕前一刻向警察辩解。“——离蒙纳洛还有很多时间！”索拉捏着鼻子避开哈利，目光移开，摆弄着双手，为自己想说的话感到难为情。

cef8e04adbab.t: 哈利手里还拿着那个计时仪器，回头看向马桶。为什么我知道那是马桶，却不知道这个计时的玩意儿？难道我是在这里出生的？在思绪之中，伊塔吉巴的声音又回到了他耳边。灵魂死亡。哈利睁大眼睛，想起了伊塔吉巴嘴里溜出来的一段对话，当时他根本没在意。所以，灵魂真的存在——牙刷？

d39876e47b32.en: Puffing, and huffing, Harry pushed his feet upstairs one at a time. His heart, pounding on his neck, as beads of sweat ran down his Bagarisa-musk-soaked skin.

d9e218dd10ca.en: Feeling compelled to know more, the stranger made his way out of the room. Near the entrance, he saw a broken glass and wooden container that had two white stones within it. d9e218dd10ca.t: 陌生人觉得自己必须多了解一些，便走出了房间。在门口附近，他看到一个破碎的玻璃和木头容器，里面有两块白色的石头。虽然模糊，但他能看到周围散落着玻璃碎片。他没理会这些，小心翼翼地踩上那扇摇摇晃晃、倒在地上的门，结果看到更多玻璃似的东西，里面装着更多发白的石头，像灯一样挂在天花板上。真奇怪。陌生人从它下面走向楼梯时眯起了眼睛。

ddd3d5c1025f.en: Is that a letter, too? The stranger felt an odd sensation as he felt Nina initially monkey around looking like she had a stroke, but as soon as she finished a stream of weird line motions, somehow the meaning of it made sense in his head. R? Is that really R?

e056ac8a60f1.en: Itagiba, with an increasingly devilish look, switched to a smoother tone. “Can you show it to him?”

Sobbing like a baby, his hand moved towards the light.
e0c95b87145d.t: 胖男人感到黑暗正把他从那光芒旁拉开，把他藏起来，把剩下的他吞噬殆尽，就像他被困在一头野兽的肚子里。就像他把刀对准自己胸口时的那种感觉，绝望和痛苦占据了一切，但与之一起的，还有一缕几乎被撕碎的希望之线。“我不想死！”他尖叫，却没有发出任何声音。他像婴儿一样啜泣着，把手伸向那道光。

e0d51c436a88.en: “Please!” Harry’s eyes shone in a glimmering radiance just like the whitish stones.
e0d51c436a88.t: “请吧！”哈利的眼睛就像那些发白的石头一样闪烁着光芒。

e157181e02f7.en: *One, two, three—*Using his finger, Harry counted a total of sixteen sections. The numbers look off. e157181e02f7.t: *一、二、三——*哈利用手指数了数，一共有十六个区段。数字好像不对。他看着索拉，她摆弄着双手，黑色的鞋子和身体都朝着门口，显然出于某种原因急着离开浴室——可能是因为那股挥之不去、越来越浓的巴加里萨臭味。“一天不是有二十四个小时吗？”

e218b256d87a.en: Sora, now the one huffing as she grabbed the half-full fost lamp out of the sink, used all her strength to shake the water to properly mix it, turning the dim lamp into a little sun that lit the bathroom in pure, blinding white light, alongside a steam noise that sounded like a tea kettle about to boil.
e218b256d87a.t: 现在轮到索拉喘粗气了，她从水槽里拿起那盏半满的福斯特灯，用尽全身力气摇晃，让水充分混合，把这盏昏暗的灯变成了一个小太阳，用纯粹刺眼的白光照亮了浴室，同时伴随着一阵像水壶快烧开时的蒸汽声。

e6d7882d0c64.en: “Nice to meet you, sir Harry.” Sora glanced towards Harry quickly, then held her cutesy hands in front of her as she bowed slightly. “I’m Sora Sanbi Blue-glass!”
e6d7882d0c64.t: “很高兴见到您，哈利先生。”索拉飞快地瞥了哈利一眼，然后把可爱的双手放在身前，微微鞠了一躬。“我是索拉·桑比·布卢格拉斯！”

e717b4291596.en: Extending her hands as far as she could towards Harry, she acquired the lamp from him, then opened the normal-looking door to the side, revealing it was a modest-looking bathroom. Stretching her arm towards a handle in the same pipe, she pulled on it with a bit of force, causing water to angrily rush out from the hole, into the funnel, shockingly gargling its way into the fost lamp—if Poseidon was ever waterboarded by a three-letter agency, it would probably sound like that.

e907867f39ee.en: Biting the inside of his cheek, the stranger shook his head. “I’m sorry, but I just don’t know.”

ea9ba9d1cf4f.en: The stranger could not see well, but he did see enough to feel a sense of impending doom; imagining this tiny girl falling, and splattering in the grass down below. A peak of energy rushed his body. He attempted to take off after her, but the king held him at the shoulder.

eb05898cbe04.en: Nothing strange happened, and with the certainty that he was relaxing in a bathtub, his shoulders involuntarily dropped, succumbing to the comforting warmth. Harry let out a grunt, his face contorting as the twisting got lower and lower in his gut, followed by a small explosion in the water, making the whole tub vibrate like a phone ringing on a wooden table. The next second, a large bubble popped in the surface of the water, and with it the stench of death cursed the air around, far more pungent than a Bagarisa’s musk. With a blanching face, he tried to fan the smell outwards, but it was not enough. Turning his head towards the window, he sloppily attacked it with one hand, luckily making it open outwardly.

f91dabeeede8.en: He remembered something painful—he had had a heart attack in that same chair, and fell to the floor as he tried to reach for his cellphone. The memory felt so real, as if it had just happened. He grabbed his heart, thinking he was still having a heart attack, but instead he felt a normal heartbeat, and a cold sauce that now laid on his chest. I’m alive? But I?—where’s the light?—wait? Isn’t this the living room?
f91dabeeede8.t: 他想起了一件痛苦的事——他曾在那把椅子上心脏病发作，伸手去够手机时摔倒在地。那段记忆感觉如此真实，仿佛刚刚才发生。他捂住心口，以为自己还在心脏病发作，结果却感到心跳正常，胸口上只有一摊凉掉的酱汁。我还活着？可我？——光呢？——等等？这不是客厅吗？

f9981abaac8c.en: N-A-R-I—nari? Huh? What is this? The stranger, with both hands, accidentally split the nari chain in half. His lips thinned into a nervous grin, while his hands quickly placed them back where he found them.

ff63ce6a55bd.t: 有个东西吸引了他的注意，他看到一个绿色的玩意儿，看起来又细又尖，像一件奇怪的长柄武器。捡起来一看，他发现它由多个绿色的小木质物件组成，包裹着一块像钻石一样的石头，每个木质物件上都有一条红线，以伪方形的样子曲折延伸，在左右边框的中点处彼此相连。
